title: Project Assistant, Metso
description:
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/c6d6529a-671b-48f7-b799-567e88253d31/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Project Assistant?

We are looking for a Project Assistant to join Metsos Document Control and Project Support team. You will be part of large international plant delivery projects, supporting delivery teams and ensuring that practical arrangements run smoothly and efficiently.

In this role, you organize travel arrangements for project personnel and customers, including flights, accommodation, and ground transportation. You prepare visa invitation letters for customers and suppliers and coordinate visa and work permit processes for project personnel across different countries.

You organize meetings both at the office and at external locations, ensuring that all arrangements are in place. You take care of ordering necessary materials such as personal protective equipment (PPE) and business gifts, and act as a key contact for travel agencies. In addition, you handle travel-related invoices and maintain up-to-date traveler profiles.

This is a full-time, one-year fixed-term position with the strong possibility of continuation. The position starts as soon as possible. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Metso. The position is based in Espoo and requires working at the office 3 days per week.

What are we looking for?

To succeed in this role, you bring a few years of experience from assistant or project support roles. You are comfortable working with MS Office tools and have experience with invoice handling and travel expense systems. You are familiar with visa and work permit processes in different countries, and you have a good understanding of travel safety and handling travel-related personal data. Fluent Finnish and English skills, both written and spoken, are essential, and additional language skills are considered an asset.

You have a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work and can prioritize effectively and adapt to changing situations. You take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating smoothly as part of a team. Experience working in an international environment and an understanding of different cultures are considered an advantage.

Why us?

We value our dedicated and driven professionals. As an important part of our highly motivated and skilled team, you contribute directly to our shared success. We offer you an exciting opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders, supported by an open-minded, international, and friendly community of experts. Once you have a solid grasp of the job, you will have the flexibility to work partly remotely, along with excellent opportunities to develop your professional skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge company at the forefront of its industry. We're committed to your success and will provide you with a comprehensive onboarding and a supportive environment where you can truly thrive. We offer occupational healthcare and a lunch benefit as employee benefits.

Are you interested?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application either in English or Finnish via the link by 23.10.2026. The interviewing process will begin during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide relocation assistance to Finland.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, email: elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi [elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi].

title: KHOY Company: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
**_Type:_** _Full-time & permanent_

**_Location:_** _Köydenpunojankatu 2 a D, 00180 Helsinki, Finland_

**_Application deadline:_** _Sunday 25.10.2026_

KHOY has proven that its product can travel. Now the ambition is bigger: to build a rapidly growing DTC success into a globally recognized consumer brand.

**The opportunity**

In just a few years, KHOY has grown from a new Finnish furniture company into an international DTC business with customers across Europe and a growing presence in the United States. Finland now represents only a small share of the business, and KHOY is entering a new stage where international growth – particularly in Central Europe, UK and the US – will define the years ahead.

The foundations are there: a distinctive product, proven demand, international traction and a team that knows how to move fast. KHOY has grown with an entrepreneurial mindset, learning through action and staying close to its customers and commercial performance. Now the company wants to complement that strength with a more strategic approach to brand and marketing.

As Chief Marketing Officer, you will have the opportunity to shape what that next chapter looks like. Your mandate is broad: build KHOY into a stronger global consumer brand while developing the marketing strategy and commercial engine needed to support significant international growth.

**What will you be doing?**

Your core challenge is to bring brand and performance together. You will define KHOYs international marketing strategy and positioning, build a stronger emotional connection between consumers and the brand, and turn that direction into concrete choices across content, performance marketing, PR, partnerships and e-commerce.

Working closely with KHOYs CEO and alongside the founders and leadership team, you will play a key role in shaping the companys growth agenda and translating business ambitions into marketing priorities. You will bring greater structure and commercial insight to marketing through systematic creative testing, customer and performance data, and continuous development of customer acquisition, conversion and e-commerce economics.

You will set priorities and budgets and decide where KHOY should invest, experiment or change direction. Together with KHOYs marketing and creative colleagues and external performance marketing and PR partners, you will bring different areas of expertise together around shared brand and commercial goals.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have built something, not only inherited it. You have personally helped grow a consumer brand internationally and understand what it takes to move from entrepreneurial growth toward meaningful scale. Experience in DTC or a digitally native consumer business is highly relevant, but what matters most is evidence of building brands and businesses across markets.

You combine brand thinking with commercial depth. You can define positioning and creative direction while also challenging assumptions around digital marketing, customer acquisition and e-commerce performance. You understand the numbers well enough to make informed decisions rather than simply outsourcing that responsibility to partners.

You are strategic, but equally comfortable getting hands-on when needed. You enjoy setting direction and enabling others to succeed, while staying close enough to the work to dig into performance and solve practical problems together with the team. You thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve quickly, and know how to bring clarity and structure without slowing down the pace.

**What we expect from you:**

- A demonstrated track record of scaling a consumer brand internationally, ideally from an entrepreneurial growth stage toward meaningful scale

- Senior-level experience in marketing or growth, with clear commercial responsibility and measurable results across multiple international markets

- Strong understanding of direct-to-consumer business and digital commerce, including performance marketing, customer acquisition, creative testing and e-commerce economics.

- Experience building both brand and demand, with the ability to connect long-term brand development with commercial performance.

- The ability to lead internal colleagues and external partners while staying close enough to the work to make informed decisions.

- Good professional English and strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


**What we consider an advantage:**

- Experience entering or growing a consumer brand in the US market, with an understanding of what it takes to succeed there

- Experience from furniture, interiors, home, lifestyle, fashion, mattresses or another design-led consumer category

- Experience developing an omnichannel business while keeping DTC at its commercial core

- First-hand experience building marketing structures and ways of working in a fast-growing scale-up environment


**At KHOY, youll have the opportunity to:**

- Step into a central leadership role and genuinely shape KHOYs brand, international growth and commercial direction

- Build a global consumer brand on the foundation of a proven product and growing international business.

- Shape KHOYs marketing strategy, ways of working and how the function develops as the company grows

- Work closely with the founder and leadership team and have a direct voice in the decisions shaping KHOYs next chapter

- Share in the long-term value you help create, with an equity or option component open for discussion


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by KHOY Company (Friends and Furniture Oy). You will report to founder and CEO Visa Friström and be part of KHOYs leadership team. The preferred location for the role is Helsinki, but KHOY is also open to candidates based elsewhere e.g. in the Nordics. If you are based outside Helsinki, the role requires flexibility to travel to Helsinki when needed and spend time working closely with the team.

The starting date will be agreed based on your availability. Compensation will also be negotiated individually based on your experience and overall profile, and an equity or option component can also be discussed.

title: Embedded electronics and integration engineer
description:
**Role summary**

You are a hands-on electronics engineer focused on fast build–assemble–test–integrate cycles for reference models and NRE projects. Your work shortens iteration loops and increases throughput across multiple customer deliveries, ensuring hardware modules are built and validated reliably.

**What youll do**

- Assemble and bring up PCBs and modules; validate electrical and optical subsystems against defined checks and acceptance criteria.Debug hardware issues efficiently (power, signals, timing, communication, sensor behavior) and document findings and fixes.

- Support integration with firmware/software teams, including effective data sharing on interfaces such as UART/SPI/I²C, timing coordination, power modes, and logging/telemetry.

- Maintain practical test setups and measurement pipelines: fixtures, rigs, scripts, checklists, build documentation, and bench discipline to ensure repeatable results and smooth transfer to manufacturing.

- Interact with manufacturing and component partners to support builds, resolve issues, and improve build quality and consistency.

- Contribute to next-generation hardware concepts through component evaluations, sensor/illumination experiments, and new integration approaches — improving delivery speed and reducing rework across NRE and customer builds.


**What we expect**

- Strong hands-on competence in embedded electronics: PCB/module assembly, bring-up, debugging, and systematic fault isolation.

- Comfort with lab instrumentation and measurement workflows (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters; building reliable test routines).

- Practical understanding of embedded interfaces and system integration constraints (UART/SPI/I²C, timing, power, signal integrity at a working level).

- Documentation discipline: you leave behind clear build notes, checklists, and test procedures others can repeat.

- Ability to work independently in a small team, prioritize effectively, and unblock others quickly.

- Experience with optical/IR components, cameras, illumination, or sensor systems is a plus.

- Embedded programming experience (including FPGA-adjacent and HDL work) is a plus, but not required.


**What we offer**

- A core role in building and validating real hardware in a deep-tech company shipping demanding sensing systems.

- Direct impact on delivery speed, reliability, and customer success; close collaboration with the founders and the core engineering team.

- Variety of work across reference designs, customer NRE builds, and next-generation prototypes.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience; potential equity participation depending on role seniority and responsibilities.

- A culture that values technical rigor, clear communication, and practical execution over bureaucracy.

- Comprehensive health-care package, gym access


**Details**

Reporting to: Chief Technology Officer

Location: Joensuu, Finland, on-site work

Travel: Infrequent

Work authorization: Relocation assistance provided

**Send or submit your CV and portfolio.**

title: Varastopäällikkö
description:
**Etsimme varastopäällikköä kehittämään ja johtamaan varastomme toimintaa**

Sun Effects Oy on suunnittelu- ja tuotantotalo, joka lisäksi vuokraa laadukasta tapahtumakalustoa ja maahantuo valaisinlaitteita.

**Valo-, nosto- ja ripustuskaluston** (rigging) lisäksi varastoimme **lavastus- ja somistemateriaalia**, joka ei aina sovellu tavanomaiseen lavavarastointiin. Jokainen kalustoryhmä vaatii oman tapansa säilyttää, pakata ja käsitellä – ja juuri siinä tarvitsemme sinun osaamistasi.

**Varastopäällikkönä** pyörität varaston arkea, johdat pientä tiimiä käytännönläheisesti ja ymmärrät kaluston liiketoiminnallisen potentiaalin. Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemuksen lisäksi omaa näkemystä varastonhallinnasta: miten tilaa, sijainteja, tavaravirtoja ja työvaiheita järjestetään niin, että kalusto löytyy, pysyy kunnossa ja liikkuu sujuvasti. Keikkojen pakkaamisesta ja purkamisesta huolehtivat yleensä projekteille palkatut teknikot.

**Tehtävässäsi**

· **Johdat varaston päivittäistä toimintaa** – keräilyt, lähtö- ja paluutarkastukset, kaluston kunnossapito ja huoltojen ohjaus, inventaariot sekä varaston järjestys, turvallisuus ja erilaisille kalustoryhmille sopivat säilytys- ja pakkausratkaisut.

· **Hallitset tavaravirrat** – varastomme kautta kulkevat myös maahantuomiemme valaisinlaitteiden lähetykset sekä päivittäiset pakettilähetykset ja -vastaanotot. Huolehdit, että saapuvat ja lähtevät toimitukset kirjataan, tarkastetaan ja lähetetään ajallaan.

· **Toimit esihenkilönä** varaston tuntityöntekijöille ja tarpeen mukaan työskenteleville freelancereille: suunnittelet työvuorot, perehdytät, jaat työt ja huolehdit, että jokainen tietää mitä tehdään ja miksi.

· **Varmistat riittävät resurssit -** buukkaat apuvoimia tarpeen mukaan huomioiden kiirehuiput ja loma-ajat.

· **Kehität vuokraustoiminnan tuloksellisuutta** – seuraat kaluston käyttöastetta ja kuntoa, tuot näkemystä hankintoihin ja hinnoitteluun, huolehdit että vauriot, puutteet ja lisätyöt kirjataan ja laskutetaan, ja palvelet vuokra-asiakkaita noudoissa ja palautuksissa.

· **Koordinoit logistiikkaa** - vastaat kuormien suunnittelusta ja kommunikoit sujuvasti tuotannon, myynnin ja logistiikkakumppaniemme kanssa kuljetusaikatauluista

· **Kehität varaston toimintaa** – sinulla on näkemystä prosessien, Rentmanin hyödyntämisen, viivakoodi-/RFID-merkintöjen, työturvallisuuden ja tilankäytön kehittämiseen.

· **Toimit kiinteässä yhteistyössä** huollon, tuottajien ja myynnin kanssa ja tuot varaston näkökulman mukaan jo projektien suunnitteluvaiheessa.

**Toivomme sinulta**

· **Ymmärrystä keikka-alan rytmistä ja halua oppia**, mitä kalusto vaatii. Kokemus tapahtuma-, AV-, valo-, ääni- tai vuokraamoalalta on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

· **Esihenkilö- tai työnjohtokokemusta**, mieluiten myös vaihtuvista keikkatyöntekijöistä.

· **Kaupallista silmää** - näet kaluston pääomana, joka hyvin hoidettuna ja oikein käytettynä tuottaa.

· **Kokemusta varastonhallinta- tai vuokrausjärjestelmistä** – käytämme Rentmania, jonka tuntemus on etu.

· **Järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä hahmottaa isoja kokonaisuuksia** – organisoit, ennakoit ja siedät painetta. Pidät langat käsissäsi, vaikka samaan aikaan on käynnissä useita tuotantoja, vuokrauksia ja toimituksia.

· **Selkeää viestintää** suomeksi ja englanniksi.

· **Sujuvia perustaitoja toimisto-ohjelmista** (esim. Microsoft 365 tai Google Workspace)

· **B-ajokorttia ja työturvallisuuskorttia.**

**Katsomme eduksi**

· Kokemus prosessien kehittämisestä

· Trukinajotaito

· C-ajokortti ja kuormansidonnan osaaminen

· Kokemus kuljetusten tai alihankkijoiden koordinoinnista ja kustannusseurannasta

**Tarjoamme**

· Keskeisen roolin kasvavassa tapahtuma-alan yrityksessä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten varasto ja vuokraus toimivat

· Vakituisen, kokoaikaisen työn monipuolisten tehtävien parissa mielenkiintoisella toimialalla

· Palkka: 3300-3800 eur/kk kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan

· Edut: liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, työterveyshuolto, puhelinetu

Työpaikka sijaitsee Helsingin Roihupellossa. Työajat painottuvat arkipäiviin, mutta alan luonteen mukaisesti työ vaatii ajoittain joustoa iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

title: KAHVILATYÖNTEKIJÄ Coffee House ja Bacaro Doppio Oulu, Osuuskauppa Arina
description:

Lisäksi koko henkilöstömme kuuluu tulospalkkauksen piiriin, sillä onnistumme yhdessä.

Nautit asiakaspalvelusta ja kohtaat asiakkaat lämpimästi, aidosti ja ammattitaitoisesti.
Työskentelet positiivisesti, ratkaisukeskeisesti ja vastuullisesti myös kiireessä.
Arvostat yhteistyötä ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi kahvila- ja ravintola-alalla.
Olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on voimassa oleva hygieniapassi. Anniskelupassi katsotaan eduksi.

description:

title: Corporate Trainer, EMEA
description:
Do you want to work in a sustainable industry that will transform our daily lives? Then join us! We have an exciting opportunity for a technically adept, customer-oriented Corporate Trainer in our EMEA organization. In this role your focus will be on developing EYKONs training offering, especially focusing on software trainings portfolio.

Your Responsibilities:

\- Developing & implementing EYKONs training strategy

\- Continuously reviewing the performance of our training offering, including tools, format and platform used. You will also identify areas of improvement and initiate changes where needed.

\- Regularly evaluate and adapt training offerings to meet evolving customer and market needs.

\- Applying best practice to develop a focused and concise application/software training portfolio and secure a modern and attractive knowledge transfer to our customers, partners and employees.

\- Delivering applications/software and device training in local language for EN, FI, and possibly Swedish.

\- Working closely with other EMEA functions, such as Customer Support, Customer Projects, Product Management, Sales & Training Team to develop trainings matching customer expectations and specificities

\- Getting to know the customers and software product portfolio in practical terms by assisting in some technical support topics

What you bring with you:

You have experience as a technical trainer and a passion for helping customers and colleagues build their knowledge and skills. Ideally, you have worked with B2B software, applications, or technical products and understand how to deliver engaging learning experiences.

You are familiar with modern training methods, including classroom training, virtual instructor-led training, e-learning, webinars, and other digital learning solutions. Experience in developing training concepts, programs, or strategies is considered an advantage.

You enjoy working in an international environment and collaborating with colleagues, customers, and partners across different cultures and functions. You are customer-focused, proactive, and able to work independently while driving improvements and new ideas.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

\- Experience delivering technical or software-related training

\- Strong presentation and communication skills

\- Fluency in English, both written and spoken

\- A collaborative and customer-oriented mindset

\- A proactive, self-driven, and hands-on approach

\- Experience working in international or matrix organizations

The following would be considered an advantage:

\- Additional European language skills, especially Finnish or Swedish

\- Knowledge of SaaS, IoT, cybersecurity, or other software-related technologies

\- Understanding of communication technologies such as LTE, G3 Powerline, and Ethernet

\- Background in electrical engineering, measurement technologies, or related technical fields

We are also driven by the mission of creating an exceptional place to work for our people, therefore we will provide you with:

\- Exciting and meaningful career in multicultural environment embracing change for a greener tomorrow

\- Talented colleagues and high performing teams

\- Versatile work tasks and support for professional development

\- Work community where we respect each other and have open information sharing

\- Flexible working model to fit individual needs

\- Wellbeing support including Epassi flex & lunch benefit, and preventive dental care support

Location: Jyväskylä or Vantaa, Finland

For more information, please contact Johanna Ekwere, johanna.ekwere@eykon-solutions.com

Ready to make an impact through learning and development? We would love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the future of EYKON's training excellence across EMEA.

Please submit your application and CV latest on 5th of November 2026.

title: Myyjä, S-market Kommila, Varkaus
description:
Primary location:
VARKAUS

S-MARKET KOMMILA etsii nyt MYYJÄÄ vakituiseen osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 15 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan marraskuussa

Marketpäällikkö Suvi kertoo työskentelystä Kommilassa näin: Meille asiakaskokemus, työyhteisön kanssa #yhdessä tekeminen ja myymälän kehittäminen ovat ykkösjuttuja. Meillä pääset tekemään laajasti erilaisia kaupan alan tehtäviä asiakaspalvelusta ja hyllytyksestä aina S-kaupat-tilausten tekemiseen.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä asiakaspalvelun, kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös S-kaupat-tilausten keräilyä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan tehtäviin. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä. Kohtaat asiakkaat aidosti ja palveluhenkisesti sekä haluat auttaa niin asiakkaita kuin työkavereitakin onnistumaan. Kaupan vaihtelevassa arjessa työ edellyttää kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti ja priorisoida tekemistä. Arvostamme reipasta ja huolellista työotetta, uteliasta asennetta sekä halua oppia jatkuvasti uutta. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja vuorot sijoittuvat noin klo 5-22 välille, joten työskentely eri vuoroissa onnistuu sinulta.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme aiempaa työkokemusta kaupan alalta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: tuntipalkka on kokemuksesta riippuen 11,16 €/t–14,93 €/t. Lisät maksetaan kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa, jos itse haluat.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.10.2026.

Lisätietoja: Marketpäällikkö Suvi Kuivisto, suvi.kuivisto@sok.fi, puh. 050 387 9482

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 136 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

title: Site Manager – Interior Construction (Data Centre)
description:
Site Manager – Interior Construction (Data Centre)

About the Position

Mono Rakennus Oy is recruiting two experienced Site Managers for our data centre construction projects in Mäntsälä and Pori, Finland.

We are looking for professionals with strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in interior construction and fit-out works, particularly Sandwich elements, drywall partitions, internal wall systems, suspended ceilings, structural ceilings (TATE-ceiling) and finishing works.

The successful candidates will be responsible for managing daily site operations, supervising construction teams, coordinating with the main contractor, and ensuring that all works are completed safely, efficiently, and according to project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and supervise daily interior construction and fit-out activities.

- Coordinate installation works, including drywall partitions, internal wall systems, suspended ceilings, doors, and finishing works.

- Plan and allocate manpower, materials, tools, and equipment.

- Monitor construction progress and ensure compliance with project schedules.

- Supervise construction workers and subcontractors.

- Coordinate daily activities with the main contractor and other trades.

- Review construction drawings, technical specifications, and installation requirements.

- Conduct quality inspections and ensure compliance with project standards.

- Ensure compliance with site HSE requirements, RAMS, and safe working procedures.

- Prepare daily and weekly progress reports, including manpower allocation and completed quantities.

- Participate in site coordination and progress meetings.

- Identify potential delays and implement practical solutions.


Requirements

- **Currently residing in Finland.**

- **Valid right to work in Finland (work permit, where applicable).**

- **Minimum 3 years of construction site management experience in Finland.**

- Proven experience in interior construction and fit-out works.

- Strong knowledge of drywall systems, internal partitions, suspended ceilings, and finishing works.

- Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

- Experience managing construction teams and coordinating multiple activities.

- Good understanding of Finnish construction practices, quality standards, and occupational safety regulations.

- Strong organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for site operations.

- Good command of English.

- Valid Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti).

- Category B driving licence.


Considered an Advantage

- Previous experience in data centre construction projects.

- Experience working with international main contractors.

title: Site Engineers (Multiple Disciplines), Granlund
description:
Are you ready to take an active role in site supervision across demanding international projects? We are now looking for Site Engineers across several technical disciplines to join Granlunds growing Site Services team.

Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/547f419b-5389-4d1d-9b3c-4499da3384d1/original.png]

Would you be one of our new Site Engineers?
As a Site Engineer, you will be responsible for site supervision within your own technical discipline, whether your expertise lies in Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical, ICT, Security, Automation, or Moisture Management. As the client's technical representative on site, you will play a key role in ensuring that technically demanding projects are executed according to approved plans, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and agreed quality standards.

In your daily work, you will monitor project progress, review installations, materials, and work phases, and ensure that execution aligns with approved plans and technical requirements. You will interpret technical drawings and project documentation, document your observations in digital systems, and help ensure that any quality issues or deviations are addressed appropriately. As a key link between the site and the wider project organization, you will provide accurate and up-to-date information on project progress and site activities.

The positions are full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The work is strongly site-based, with projects located throughout Finland. The most suitable project location will be discussed during the recruitment process. The role requires regular presence at project sites and readiness to travel.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for professionals who enjoy working close to construction and industrial projects and want to take responsibility for quality and technical execution on site. You have experience in site supervision, quality control, or technical project environments, along with a relevant engineering degree and the ability to interpret technical drawings, plans, and project documentation.

Your background may, for example, be in Civil, Structural or Architectural Engineering, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical Engineering, ICT, Security, Automation or Moisture Management. Regardless of your discipline, you have a few years of experience working on construction or industrial projects and are comfortable operating in a site-based environment.

Experience with Dalux or Autodesk Construction Cloud is considered an advantage. Fluent English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. You will also need a valid driving licence and readiness to work regularly at project sites.

You are proactive, quality-conscious, and eager to develop your expertise. You take responsibility for your work, communicate effectively with different stakeholders, and are not afraid to raise concerns when quality, safety, or project requirements are at risk.

Why join us?
At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

Are you interested?
Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 18.10.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period may close the job posting earlier if the positions are filled.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (nea.repo@biisoni.fi [nea.repo@biisoni.fi]).

title: Myyntineuvottelija Huutokaupat.comille, Helsinki
description:
Etsimme Huutokaupat.comille aktiivista ja tavoitteellista myyntineuvottelijaa, joka innostuu asiakaskohtaamisista, neuvotteluista ja kauppojen kotiuttamisesta. Jos olet rohkea tarttumaan puhelimeen, nautit myyntityöstä ja haluat nähdä työsi tulokset konkreettisesti, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Työnkuva:

Huutokaupat.com on yksi Suomen tunnetuimmista verkkomarkkinapaikoista, jossa yli miljoona suomalaista vierailee kuukausittain tutustumassa monipuolisiin huutokauppakohteisiin. Myyntineuvottelijana pääset osaksi palvelun myyntitiimiä ja vaikutat suoraan siihen, kuinka moni huutokauppa johtaa onnistuneeseen kauppaan.

Tehtävässäsi käyt läpi päättyneitä huutokauppoja ja tunnistat tilanteita, joissa kauppa on vielä mahdollista saada syntymään. Otat yhteyttä huutajiin, käyt hintaneuvotteluja ja etsit ratkaisuja, joiden avulla sekä ostaja että myyjä pääsevät molempia tyydyttävään lopputulokseen.

Työhösi kuuluu myös tiivis yhteistyö myyjien ja muun myyntitiimin kanssa. Tavoitteenasi on edistää myyntimahdollisuuksia, saavuttaa asetetut tavoitteet ja varmistaa, että asiakkaat saavat hyvää palvelua koko prosessin ajan.

Toivomme sinulta:

Tavoitteellista, aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta.
Myyntihenkisyyttä ja hyviä neuvottelutaitoja.
Rohkeutta kontaktoida asiakkaita ja edistää kauppojen syntymistä.
Kykyä kuunnella asiakasta ja löytää molempia osapuolia hyödyttäviä ratkaisuja.
Asiakaslähtöistä asennetta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja.
Hyvää suomenkielen taitoa sekä riittävää englanninkielen osaamista asiakastilanteiden hoitamiseen tarvittaessa.

Aiempi kokemus HubSpotista tai muusta CRM-järjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi. Myös huutokauppaliiketoiminnan tuntemus ja muu kielitaito ovat plussaa, mutta aiempaa kokemusta huutokauppa-alalta ei vaadita.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Pääset osaksi rentoa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen on tavoitteellista mutta ilmapiiri välitön. Työkavereilta saat tukea ja sparrausta, ja onnistumisia rakennetaan yhdessä. Tarjoamme sinulle nykyaikaiset työvälineet, toimivat työskentelytavat ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi osana tunnettua ja kasvavaa verkkomarkkinapaikkaa.

Työsuhde alkaa kuuden kuukauden määräaikaisella jaksolla Bolt.Worksin kautta. Hyvälle tekijälle voi avautua mahdollisuus jatkaa tämän jälkeen Huutokaupat.comin omilla kirjoilla.

Työsuhteen tiedot:

Aloitus: Mahdollisimman pian.
Työaika: 37,5 tuntia viikossa, maanantaista perjantaihin.
Työajat: Liukuva työaika klo 6–19 välillä.
Työntekopaikka: Toimisto sijaitsee Helsingin Ruoholahdessa, mutta työskentely onnistuu myös muualla Suomessa.
Palkkaus: Kiinteä kuukausipalkka noin 1800–2 400 euroa sekä provisio. Provisioiden määrä on arviolta 300–700 euroa kuukaudessa, joten kokonaisansioihin voi vaikuttaa omalla tekemisellään.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos nautit myyntityöstä, viihdyt neuvottelutilanteissa ja haluat olla mukana viemässä kauppoja maaliin, tämä voi olla sinulle sopiva mahdollisuus.

Tutustu Huutokaupat.comiin ja sen toimintaan tarkemmin:

Verkkopalvelu: https://huutokaupat.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/huutokaupatcom
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/huutokaupatcom/
LinkedIn: https://fi.linkedin.com/company/huutokaupat.com

Tule mukaan tekemään onnistuneita kauppoja ja kehittämään Suomen kiinnostavinta markkinapaikkaa!

title: Chef, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
description:
StaffPoint is looking for CHEFS for the winter season 2026–2027 at Lapland Hotels SnowVillage.

Every year in November, a unique frozen experience is built in Lainio, covering an area of about 2 hectares. It features stunning ice sculptures, an ice restaurant and an ice bar. Reception and kitchen facilities, however, are warmly housed within log walls. The SnowVillage attracts around 80,000 visitors annually and its theme changes every year. Located near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts, the location ensures a vibrant winter season. The distance is approx. 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The position includes duties in both à la carte and buffet kitchen operations. Employment is scheduled to begin on 23 November 2026 and continue until approximately 4 April 2027. Full-time work is available, with 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be signed between the employee and StaffPoint. Please note that the Lapland Hotels chain is a smoke-free workplace.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a kitchen as a chef

- Creativity, initiative, and a positive attitude that is reflected in your way of working

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A great, close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so having your own car or a valid driving licence will be considered an advantage.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit - toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

- Sinulla on soveltuva rakennusalan korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi rakennusmestarin, rakennusinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto.

- Sinulla on vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyys tai valmiudet hakea sitä sekä osaamista toimia vastaavana työnjohtajajana.

- Työmaan eri työvaiheet ovat sinulle tuttuja ja hallitset tarvittavien työmaasuunnitelmien ja -dokumentaation laatimisen.

- Pystyt johtamaan ja priorisoimaan useita samanaikaisia hankkeita ja työvaiheita.

- Osaat johtaa aliurakoitsijoita ja tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri osapuolten kanssa.

- Sinulla on toimiva ja kattava rakennusalan yhteistyö- ja aliurakoitsijaverkosto.

- Toimit käytännönläheisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti sekä viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin.

- Turvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat toimintaasi.

- Hallitset tietotekniset työvälineet ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi.


Kokemus koulu-, päiväkoti- tai muista julkisista rakennushankkeista sekä moduuli-, elementti- tai teollisesta rakentamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös erittäin vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyyttä, muuta kielitaitoa ja Dalux-osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa johdat työmaan toteutusta ja vaikutat suoraan hankkeen onnistumiseen.

- Monipuolisia, yhteisöille tärkeitä rakennushankkeita pääosin koulu- ja päiväkotisektorilla.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työmaidemme toimintatapoja.

- Osaavan projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan ja tuotannon tuen.

- Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi perustuvan palkan sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvittavat työvälineet.


**Haku ja lisätiedot**

Haastatteluihin edetään arviolta viikoilla 45–46. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tehtävän esihenkilö, työpäällikkö Jussi Lavikainen, p. 040 145 5221.

title: Legal Trainees @ Stora Enso
description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

**This position is a perfect fit for you if you have:**

- at least 180 credits of completed legal studies and a background in diverse legal tasks from previous internships;

- a proactive and self-driven approach to accomplishing tasks and an ability to learn quickly;

- an analytical mindset and the competence to prioritize conflicting demands from multiple business clients in a fast-paced environment;

- a curious mindset and a strong willingness to learn; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required.


**Stora Enso offers you:**

- a unique opportunity to learn about the tasks and responsibilities of the legal department within an international corporation;

- a possibility to work on versatile assignments with highly skilled professionals;

- modern, high-quality office spaces in a prime location; and

- a diverse working culture with a low hierarchy and support from your team when needed.


_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso creates better choices for society by accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

If this sounds like the perfect next career move for you, please send us your CV, cover letter, and up-to-date transcript of studies by **20 October 2026** to get the conversation going! title: Director, M&A Legal @ UPM
description:
**Hey lawyer with a proven track-record in M&A,**

Are you ready to take the lead on strategic transactions in a multinational and multifaceted business environment? Do you find meaning in using your skills to promote sustainable and innovation-driven future in a global material solutions company?

If these sound like your career goals, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **UPM** as a **Director, M&A Legal** in a newly established role.

_UPM is entering an exciting phase where strategic transactions continue to play an important role in shaping our future. We are building a dedicated M&A Legal capability to support that journey, and we are looking for a business-minded lawyer who enjoys collaboration, takes ownership and thrives in helping organizations navigate complex opportunities and change._

**\-Markus Skrabb, VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal**

**As a Director, M&A Legal**, you will join UPM's Legal and Compliance function. The role is preferably based in Helsinki, Finland (or other UPM location), and you will report to VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal.

**In this role,** you will take a leading, hands-on role in mergers, acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic transactions. You will operate across UPM's business areas and geographical footprint, and work with business area leaders, senior management, Legal and Compliance colleagues, other corporate functions and external advisers. In addition to legal support in transactions, you will contribute to developing consistent, efficient and practical M&A legal ways of working across UPM.

**Your key responsibilities will include**:

- leading and coordinating legal workstreams in acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, reorganizations and other strategic transactions;

- providing pragmatic, commercially focused advice to transaction teams, business leadership and senior management;

- coordinating legal due diligence and translating material findings into contractual protections, risk-mitigation actions and clear decision-making materials;

- drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share and asset purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements and ancillary documents;

- planning and coordinating signing, closing and transaction implementation activities;

- working with legal specialists and other functions on merger control, compliance, finance, tax, sustainability, employment, intellectual property, data protection and other relevant matters;

- managing external legal advisers, including scope, resourcing, quality and cost; and

- developing UPM's M&A legal governance, templates, playbooks and transaction tools (including legal tech & AI solutions), and promoting lessons learned and knowledge sharing.


The role involves travel according to transaction activity. UPM's team members currently work based on a hybrid work policy, but due to the collaborative and fast-paced nature of this role, frequent office presence is preferred.

**You could be an ideal candidate if you:**

- are an experienced M&A lawyer with a masters degree in law (or an equivalent legal qualification), who combines strong transaction expertise with sound business judgement and a practical, solution-oriented approach;

- have substantial M&A experience from a reputable law firm, an international company or a combination of both, in which context you have led complex domestic and cross-border transactions and have strong experience in legal due diligence as well as assessing, drafting and negotiating transaction documentation;

- take ownership, communicate clearly and move complex matters forward in demanding and time-sensitive situations;

- are a credible leader and influencer who can build trust across the organization, aligning stakeholders with different perspectives, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority;

- understand transaction structures and the interaction between legal, commercial, financial, tax, regulatory and operational considerations;

- can translate legal risks into clear, proportionate and actionable advice and have strong leadership, influencing, project-management, stakeholder-management and negotiation skills;

- work effectively with business leaders, internal specialists, external counsel and counterparties;

- are proactive, structured and comfortable managing several workstreams under pressure; and

- have excellent written and spoken English (Finnish or other relevant language skills are an advantage). Experience in listed-company transactions, carve-outs, joint ventures, merger control, foreign investment screening or post-merger integration is an advantage.


**UPM offers you:**

- **A meaningful role**: You will contribute directly to UPM's strategic development by supporting in transactions of significant importance to the company.

- **A key role with broad exposure**: You will work across UPM's businesses, functions, countries and organizational boundaries, including with senior management.

- **An opportunity to build**: As the first dedicated M&A Legal resource, you will help shape UPM's shared M&A legal practices, governance, tools and institutional knowledge.

- **Inspired and motivated colleagues**: You will join an experienced, collaborative and international Legal and Compliance community.

- **Development opportunities**: The role offers varied and demanding transaction work and broad exposure to UPM's businesses, strategy and operating environment.

- **Responsibility for people and the environment**: UPM's ethical principles embrace people and the environment, and the company continuously works to build a more sustainable future.


**_UPM_** _is a material solutions company, renewing products and entire value chains with an extensive portfolio of renewable fibers, advanced materials, decarbonization solutions, and communication papers. UPM's performance in sustainability has been recognized by third parties, including EcoVadis and the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices. UPM operates globally and employs approximately 15,100 people worldwide, with annual sales of approximately €9.7 billion. UPM's shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd._

title: Senior Researcher (1 position) Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North
description:
The Faculty of Law at the University of Lapland is hiring a Senior Research Fellow for the Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North project.

The aim of the Arctic Transitions (AT) project is to critically examine how rapidly changing climatic conditions and a race to extract rare and valuable earth materials have made Arctic regions the focus of new extractive possibilities, as well as a laboratory for testing who controls these possibilities.

To meet this aim, the AT project is hiring a team to conduct comparative multidisciplinary research at locations across Arctic nations to explore:

- How and why changing climatic conditions and new resource demands are shaping extraction activities, infrastructures, security configurations, and governance arrangements.

- The impact of these activities and arrangements on the people and communities who live in these regions.

- How and why energy security and energy transition narratives are being mobilised, by whom, and to what end.

- How and why these activities, infrastructures, configurations and arrangements are connected to, and entangled with, international legal provisions and flows of capital.

This is an exciting and unique opportunity to be a core member of a cutting-edge research team, in an area of research that is fast-moving and of geopolitical significance.

It is a full-time, funded, 30-month research position, based in Rovaniemi, with the possibility of remote working. The prospective start date is August 2027, although an earlier start date is possible (to be negotiated).

Work tasks

The successful candidate will be a core and active member of the Arctic Transitions team. They will carry out independent research, work in close collaboration with the projects Principal Investigator, and take on leadership roles within the AT team. In particular, the selected candidate will:

- Conduct independent field research and data collection at selected field locations, to be chosen by the candidate in collaboration with the PI.

- Produce solo- and jointly-authored articles and chapters for top-tier peer-reviewed academic publishers.

- Present research results at national and international conferences.

- Contribute to the planning of an international conference to be hosted in Rovaniemi.

- Contribute to AT project planning and project administration.

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer. Tasks in teaching may occur to a small extent.

Competence

Prospective candidates must:

- Have a PhD in law, policy, geography, economics, environmental studies, sociology, anthropology, science and technology studies, or related field.

- Have a publication record commensurate with their career stage.

- Be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking English at an academic level.

Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Finnish will be considered a merit. Demonstrable experience working in a research team will also be considered a merit.

What we Offer

- An opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary research team.

- An opportunity to conduct funded primary data collection (qualitative, quantitative, mixed method, etc.).

- An opportunity to be a part of an international university community.

- An opportunity to build and advance a research portfolio.

- Modern work equipment and facilities.

- A stable organisation to work in.

- Opportunities for professional development.

- Extensive occupational health services.

- Sport, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Prospective candidates should submit their application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Applications must include:

- Cover letter (maximum 1 page)

- Curriculum vitae (cv)

- Research proposal (max. 3 pages, single spaced, 12-point font)

Research proposals should include:

- The region and/or location of the proposed field research

- The methodological approach to data collection and analysis

- A timeline for data collection, analysis, and writing

- Proposed research outputs

Short-listed candidates selected for an interview will be contacted by email. Interviews will be conducted online in January 2027.

Information

For further information about the position, please contact Sean Field, Principal Investigator at firstname.lastname@ulapland.fi and +358 4014 95972. Candidates are encouraged to get in touch with the PI prior to submitting their application.

Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 30 months 1.8.2027 - 31.12.2029, an earlier start date is possible (to be negotiated).
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is made up of a task-specific salary component namely the demand level and a personal salary component namely the performance percentage. The task-specific salary for a senior researcher ranges from demand level 5 (3 366,36 €/ month) to demand level 7 (4 525,66 €/ month). The personal salary component can typically range from 19,1% to 30%. The starting salary for Senior Researcher ranges between 4 009,33 € / month (demand level 5, performance 19,1%) and 5 390,06 € / month (demand level 7, performance 19,1%).

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

title: Purchasing Specialist
description:
**About Sine Engineering**

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, including communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technology, and our solutions power many of today's active interceptor operations.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

**Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere.**

We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive **Purchasing Specialist** to develop and manage our Finland offices end-to-end procurement activities from creating purchase orders and validating supplier confirmations to ensuring timely deliveries and resolving shortages. You will maintain daily communication with suppliers, support onboarding and RFQ processes.

What we need is a strong procurement professional who will thrive in a global role with a lot of independence and responsibility, with the potential to grow into team leadership.

In this position you will be building the procurement process in Finland together with your international colleagues and manager. Your colleagues and stakeholders are spread across several countries, so you'll work in an international collaboration setup, but you will as well work closely with our Engineering and Finance teams, so you should have a good understanding of the Finnish procurement field.

With us you'll learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company. Because this is a key role in Finland, it is also an opportunity to develop something new, and a possibility grow into a leadership position.

**Location:** Tampere, on-site, fulltime, permanent position

**Key responsibilities**

- Create and manage purchase orders (POs) based on MRP, requisitions, or project needs


- Validate order confirmations: prices, delivery dates, quantities


- Follow up with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery


- Resolve delivery delays, shortages, and discrepancies.


- Follow up with warehouse team to have proper receiving within WH


- Maintain day-to-day communication with suppliers


- Support onboarding new suppliers by collecting documents and coordinating approval flows


- Request quotes (RFQs) and compare proposal


- Provide purchasing support during new product development (NPI)


- Support engineering changes (ECR/ECO) by updating suppliers and adjusting POs


**What we require**

To succeed in this role, you should have:

- Good knowledge of Finnish procurement process, limitations and constraints

- Good understanding of purchasing processes (RFQ, RFI, POs, contracts, and incoterms)

- Supplier management skills (evaluation, onboarding, performance tracking)


- Cost analysis skills like ability to compare quotes, calculate landed cost, evaluate TCO


- Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)


- Basic contract understanding like payment terms, delivery terms, warranty clauses etc.


- Strong ability to analyze prices, trends, and delivery performance


- Proficiency with Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation)


- Understanding demand planning and how it impacts purchasing


- English: B2 or higher


**What we see as a plus**

- Experience working at EMS factories

- Highly adaptable mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and solve problems beyond previous experience


**What We Offer**

**Paid Time Off**

The Employee is entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**

- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the taxfree limit as a fringe benefit.


- Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies.


- Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support.


- Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care.


- Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time.


- Business Travel Insurance: coverage for workrelated travel.


- Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks.


**Work Model**

- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00.


- NoCrunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed.


- MeetingLight Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings.


**Growth & Innovation**

- HighEnd Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals.


- Lab & Gadget Budget: annual budget for hardware, tools, books, and learning materials.


- Hackathons & Offsites: regular internal events focused on innovation and technology.


**Travel & Mobility**

- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation.


- Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum taxfree Vero rates.


**Impact & Culture**

- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement.


**Culture Statement**

Dont meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesnt perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.

Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.

**Privacy Notice**

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

Your data will be handled in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. We will retain your application data for up to 2 years, unless you consent to a longer retention period.

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting: privacy@sineeng.com

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.

description:
**Huoltopesti avoinna Vantaalla**

_Peukalo harvoin keskellä kämmentä, hoksottimet aina pelikunnossa? Vatupassin Vantaan vuokraamolle etsitään rakennuskoneiden korjaamiseen perehtynyttä huollon työntekijää!_

Yleiskonevuokraamo Vatupassin Vantaan toimipisteelle haetaan käsistään kätevää ja nopeilla hoksottimilla varustettua huollon tekijää kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Korjaamomme ja huollon työntekijöidemme käsien läpi kulkee vuodessa satoja Vatupassin vuokrauskalustoon kuuluvia rakennuskoneita (mm. erilaisia nostimia, maantiivistimiä, kuukulkijoita ja monia erilaisia pienkoneita). Jos vempaimien vikojen diagnosointi, korjaus ja määräaikainen huolto luonnistuu sinulta ilman, että peukalo karkaa keskelle kämmentä, hae hommiin!

**Mitä odotamme hakijalta:**

- Monipuolista aiempaa kokemusta rakennuskoneiden huollosta ja korjauksesta

- Tietotaitoa sähkö- ja/tai hydrauliikkatekniikasta

- Täsmällistä ongelmanratkaisu- ja oivalluskykyä

- Eduksi katsotaan tehtävään soveltuva tekninen koulutus (esim. raskaskoneasentaja tai ajoneuvoasentaja)


Vastineeksi tarjoamme rehtiä palkkaa ja minimaalisen vähän nipottamista ja turhantärkeilyä. Emme ole (vielä) Suomen suurin konevuokraamo, mutta haluamme olla paras – ja sehän lähtee mahdollisimman hyvinvoivasta henkilöstöstä. Laajojen työterveyspalveluiden ja työkykyvakuutuksen lisäksi tarjoamme kaikille työntekijöillemme sähköpyöräedun, myynti-, kunto- ja tupakoimattomuusbonusta sekä panostamme reiluuteen ja työssä viihtymiseen.

**Mikä Vatupassi?**

Vatupassi on perheomisteinen konevuokraamoyritys, jonka toimipisteet sijaitsevat Joensuussa, Jyväskylässä, Kuopiossa, Nurmeksessa, Oulussa, Tampereella, Turussa sekä Vantaalla. Olemme osa kansainvälistä Avesco Groupia, joka toimii Suomen lisäksi kotimaassaan Sveitsissä, Itävallassa sekä Baltian maissa.

Vatupassilaista kulttuuria leimaa perheomisteisen yrityksen reiluus, joustavuus ja oikeudenmukaisuus. Meillä omista pidetään huolta. Ja se tarkoittaa sitä, että vastuuta kannetaan yhdessä, luotetaan toinen toisiimme ja autetaan työkaveria ilman mikromanageerausta.

Olet innostunut oppimaan uutta ja nautit vaihtelevista työpäivistä. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää sekä mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa aamu-, päivä- ja iltavuoroissa ABC:n aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
Ihan tavallisia töitä erityisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakua täältä.
Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 13,13–14,93 € /h. Ja lisät päälle!
Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.
Työn ja vapaa-ajan sujuvamman yhteensovittamisen vaikuttamalla itse omiin työvuoroihisi. Uudessa mallissa työntekijät voivat valita itselleen sopivia työvuoroja sovittujen pelisääntöjen mukaisesti.
Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.
Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko omassa tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.
Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana. Piihovissa sinua odottaa lähes 30 hengen tiimi valmiina hommiin kanssasi!

💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen

Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: marraskuussa sopimuksen mukaan

Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025.
