title: Legal Trainees @ Stora Enso
description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

**This position is a perfect fit for you if you have:**

- at least 180 credits of completed legal studies and a background in diverse legal tasks from previous internships;

- a proactive and self-driven approach to accomplishing tasks and an ability to learn quickly;

- an analytical mindset and the competence to prioritize conflicting demands from multiple business clients in a fast-paced environment;

- a curious mindset and a strong willingness to learn; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required.


**Stora Enso offers you:**

- a unique opportunity to learn about the tasks and responsibilities of the legal department within an international corporation;

- a possibility to work on versatile assignments with highly skilled professionals;

- modern, high-quality office spaces in a prime location; and

- a diverse working culture with a low hierarchy and support from your team when needed.


_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso creates better choices for society by accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

**Did we pique your interest?**

If this sounds like the perfect next career move for you, please send us your CV, cover letter, and up-to-date transcript of studies by **20 October 2026** to get the conversation going! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

title: Ethics & Compliance Counsel @ Stora Enso
description:
**Hey Ethics & Compliance professional!**

Are you looking for a diverse role in ethics and compliance within a listed company? Would you be excited to join a team where your work helps build a more sustainable future?

If you are thinking **YES**, please keep reading because we are now looking for **a Legal Counsel, Ethics & Compliance** to join **Stora Enso's Ethics and Compliance Team**!

**In this role**, as a member of the Ethics and Compliance team, you will work with assignments on group level, and, at the same time, serve as the dedicated Ethics and Compliance resource for one or several of Stora Enso's Business Areas. More specifically, you will:

- Serve as the dedicated E&C resource for assigned Business Area(s), providing proactive and reactive legal support including risk assessments, policy interpretation, and compliance investigations

- Monitor relevant regulatory developments in Finland and across the EU, covering anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations

- Draft, update, and implement E&C policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent understanding and application across the organisation

- Develop and deliver E&C training and awareness initiatives, both in person, online and through e-learning programmes

- Contribute as an integrated member of the Group E&C team, taking ownership of group-level projects and supporting the Chief Compliance Officer as needed


Together with your team, you will also attempt to manage information in digital form by using AI, and thus continuously work towards making the routines more efficient and better.

**The Ethics and Compliance team** consists of 6 professionals in several global locations. The team is spread across multiple locations but operates as a genuinely close-knit group, with strong connections and active day-to-day collaboration across geographies. Team members support one another and are encouraged to challenge each other constructively. This is a team where you are expected to contribute, grow, and be heard - ambition is welcomed, and opportunities for development are real.

The position is based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki, but the position also involves occasional, pre-planned travel, mostly within Europe. You will report to the Chief Compliance Officer, who is based in Sweden.

**This position is a great fit for a candidate who has:**

- a Finnish law degree or other education and experience the employer deems relevant for this position;

- at least five years of relevant experience in ethics and compliance in an international environment, whether in-house or at a law firm;

- a strong knowledge of competition law, anti-corruption, trade sanctions, grievance handling and investigations, as well as business ethics and corporate values more broadly;

- a good understanding of the fast-moving regulatory landscape relevant to corporate ethics and compliance, including developments at both the Finnish and EU levels, particularly in the areas of anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations;

- project management experience and experience of rolling out cross-functional programmes in international organisations;

- proven integrity and high ethical standards as well as a strong drive to get things done and the ability to perform well under pressure and meet tight deadlines;

- strong interpersonal skills and a team player mindset; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required. Additional language skills, such as Swedish, German, Polish, Dutch or Chinese, are considered an advantage.


**What Stora Enso offers you:**

**A place for professional growth:** Stora Enso's innovative and high-speed environment offers you an opportunity to constantly develop professionally at all stages of your career.

**A diverse working culture:** You get to be part of highly skilled team within an international corporation where everyone is treated fairly and with respect.

**A commitment to sustainability:** Sustainability is at the core of Stora Enso's everyday activities, reflecting a strong commitment to compliance and doing things the right way.

**Benefits to support your well-being:** Besides industry-standard salary, you will receive a wide scale of benefits to support your health and well-being – of which we are happy to tell you more in our conversations.

_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. They believe that everything that is made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and their sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion. Stora Enso shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Oy (STEAV, STERV) and Nasdaq Stockholm AB (STE A, STE R). In addition, the shares are traded in the USA as ADRs (SEOAY)._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

title: Vibration Engineer
description:
We are looking for aVibration Engineerwith a main responsibility for delivering noise and vibration engineering analyses,measurementsand solutions for marine projects during the sales and project execution phases. The preferred location for this permanent position isVaasa, Finland.We offer possibility for hybrid work.

Your role and responsibilities

As aVibration Engineer, you will work in a global,innovativeand customer-driven organisation.This delivery-oriented role focuseson providing high-quality engineering analysis and solutionsthatmeet projectneedsand customerexpectations. Your work may include performing noise and vibration measurements during factory acceptance testing of generating sets for advanced passenger and research vessels, as well as presenting vibration analysis results and selected power transmission solutions forcutting-edgehybrid ferry projects. You willbe working as part of our skilled Noise & Vibration Engineering team within Customer Solution Engineering in Power Supply,providing specialistexpertiseacross all marine projects.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Perform noise and vibration measurements during engine factory acceptance tests
* Participatein delivery projects as the Noise & Vibration Engineer in the project team
* Perform torsional vibration calculations in both frequency and time domains
* Perform resilient mounting calculations
* Create technical specificationsin accordance withinternal standards
* Prepare and deliver detailed measurement and calculation reports to customers and classificationsocieties
* Provide technicalexpertiseand support to internal and external stakeholders on noise and vibration topics
* Develop measurement and analysis methodologies and technical solutions together with internal stakeholders and suppliers


To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering field
* Strong background in mathematics and physics
* Fundamental knowledge of structural dynamics,vibrationand modal analysis
* Interest in internal combustion engines
* Fluent written and spoken English and solid MS Office skills. Finnish orSwedish language skill is considered as an advantage
* Analytical mindset and a systematic,proactiveand organised way of working
* Practical problem-solving approach and strong technical reporting skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international environment, with willingness to learn and adoptnew technologies


The following are considered an advantage:

* Practical experience in linear vibration, airborne noise, torsionalvibrationor modal measurements
* Knowledge of signal processing
* Experience of or interest in engine dynamics
* Experience with data acquisition system hardware and transducers
* Knowledge of relevant ISO standards related to noise and vibration
* Experience with torsional vibration analysis or marine power systems


Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment,ownershipand taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you canaccomplishso much more. Wedontalways get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon bysubmittingyour application through ourcareersportal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For further questions, please reach out toFrancescoLicciulli,Manager, Noise & Vibration Engineering, throughfrancesco.licciulli@wartsila.comwith any questions related to this position (only for questions from direct job applicants, applications through email will not be recorded or responded to).

Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Poriin
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

title: Project Engineer (electrical and automation), Wärtsilä, Vaasa
description:
About the role

As a Project Engineer, you will manage technical automation solutions, oversee schedules, budgets, and quality standards, and support the project manager in coordinating tasks across stakeholders. Your responsibilities include managing engineering, procurement, and logistics, as well as supporting risk management and reporting. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and external vendors to ensure adherence to contract specifications. The role requires occasional global travel to project sites. While the role demands responsibility and ownership taking, you will work closely with project managers and senior engineers to ensure successful project execution.

You are offered
- An interesting position in projects, where you can develop your skills and excel as a professional
- A working environment and a team, that will support you in your daily tasks

Work tasks
- Support and coordinate technical solutions, schedules, budgets, and quality standards within projects
- Ensure adherence to contract specifications and provide regular project reporting
- Collaborate with internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution

We are looking for

- Relevant educational background and interest in electrical and automation engineering
- Some years of experience working in project business, preferably in energy sector
- Technical understanding of engine power plants and automation solutions applied there
- Strong communication and collaboration skills with hefty amount of can-do-attitude; for example act as a substitute to Project Manager and/or Chief Project Engineer when needed
- Fluency in English, with Finnish as a plus

Previous experience from power plants, or retrofit projects is considered beneficial.

As a person you are:
- A good team player with strong problem-solving skills
- Precise and you have an accurate way of working
- Independent and responsible

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Palvelukoordinaattori / ANNU sosiaalipalvelut, Pirkanmaa
description:
ANNU sosiaalipalvelut etsii oma-aloitteista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä palvelukoordinaattoria kokoaikaiseen tehtävään kotiin vietäviin sosiaalipalveluihin Pirkanmaalle.

Työ koostuu palvelutoiminnan koordinoinnista ja asiakastyöstä. Koordinointitehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, rekrytointi, työntekijöiden ja asiakkuuksien käytännön järjestelyt sekä muut hallinnolliset tehtävät. Tehtävässä toimitaan palvelujohtajan alaisuudessa.

**Asiakastyön osuus on lähtökohtaisesti noin 50 prosenttia työajasta. Osuus voi toiminnan tarpeiden mukaan kasvaa enintään 100 prosenttiin.** Asiakastyöhön kuuluvat perhetyö ja tehostettu perhetyö, ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö sekä tuettu asuminen.

Työ tehdään Tampereen toimipisteellämme Ratinassa ja asiakaskohteissa Pirkanmaan alueella. Tehtävässä ei ole etätyömahdollisuutta. Koordinointityö ajoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo 8–16. **Asiakastyötä tehdään myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.**

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa sosiaali- tai terveysalan AMK-tutkintoa ja tehtävän edellyttämää voimassa olevaa ammattioikeutta. Lisäksi odotamme:

- hyviä asiakaspalvelu-, viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja kykyä asioida englanniksi; ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi

- valmiutta käyttää asiakastietojärjestelmiä ja oppia uusia järjestelmiä

- oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta

- hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja

- joustavuutta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa.


Aikaisempi kokemus koordinointitehtävistä ja kotiin vietävistä sosiaalipalveluista katsotaan eduksi. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on eduksi asiakastyössä. Tarjoamme merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn, kattavan perehdytyksen sekä esihenkilön ja tiimin tuen. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Palkka määräytyy yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaluokan **G24D** mukaan. Kuukausipalkka on hyväksyttävästä palvelusajasta riippuen **2 811,09–3 071,09 euroa**. Lisäksi maksetaan TES mukaiset työaikalisät.

Palveluslisään oikeuttava työkokemus arvioidaan TES mukaisesti työtodistusten perusteella. Huomioon otetaan tehtävässä olennaisesti hyödyttävä aikaisempi työkokemus.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Sopivan henkilön löydyttyä valinta voidaan tehdä ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Käytämme ensimmäisen kierroksen haastatteluissa Teams-yhteyttä.

Lisätiedot: Tiina Helin, **tiina@annu.fi**, **044 901 8526**.

title: Svenskspråkig vårdare åt sympatisk kund på Kimitoön
description:
**Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**

Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund på Kimitoön

Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!

Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**

Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Vad gör en vård helppare?**

En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.

Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

- hjälp vid dusch

- uppföljning av hur senioren mår

- stöd för att klara sig hemma

- stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet


Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.

**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**

Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.

Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.

Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?

Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:

Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.

Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.

Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.

Som vård helppare får du:

- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka.

- **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön!


Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.

**Skicka in din ansökan som vårdare-helpper här.**

**Läs mer om Hemby genom att klicka här.**

Om du har frågor om att bli vårdare-helpper, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

title: Aarre Avustajat - Henkilökohtainen avustaja - Keski-Uusimaa
description:
Etsitkö mukavaa ja joustavaa palkkatyötä ilman koulutus- tai tutkintovaatimusta? Haluatko itse vaikuttaa omaan työmäärääsi sekä siihen, missä ja milloin työskentelet? Koetko muiden ihmisten auttamisen tärkeäksi ja haluat tehdä työtä, josta jää hyvä mieli?

Mikäli vastasit yllä oleviin kysymyksiin kyllä, suosittelemme sinulle henkilökohtaisen avustajan töitä Aarre Avustajilla. Alta löydät lisätietoja Aarre Avustajista ja henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä sekä linkin työnhakulomakkeeseen, jonka kautta voit hakea meille helposti töihin ilman erillistä CV:tä. Otathan rohkeasti yhteyttä, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää!

Helposti täytettävän työnhakulomakkeen löydät tästä linkistä: https://www.tuntinetti.fi/AarreAvustajatHakulomake.html

TÖITÄ TARJOLLA HENKILÖKOHTAISENA AVUSTAJANA
Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme uusia henkilökohtaisia avustajia tärkeään, mutta joustavaan avustustyöhön. Työ on palkkatyötä yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja sopii niin kokopäiväistä, osa-aikaista, satunnaista kuin keikkatyötäkin etsivälle hyvälle tyypille. Henkilökohtaisena avustajana saat itse määritellä, kuinka paljon ja milloin työskentelet, joten avustajan työ sopii myös toisen työn tai opiskelun ohelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla erityistä koulutusta avustajan työhön, vaan oikea asenne ja luotettavuus ovat tärkeimmät ominaisuudet erinomaiselle henkilökohtaiselle avustajalle. Aarre Avustajilla saat jatkuvan tuen ja ohjauksen omalta toimihenkilöltäsi, etkä jää koskaan asioittesi tai kysymyksiesi kanssa yksin, sen lupaamme.

MITÄ HENKILÖKOHTAINEN APU ON JA MITÄ AVUSTAJA TEKEE?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, jossa henkilökohtainen avustaja toimii asiakkaan käsinä ja jalkoina toteuttaen niitä toimia, jotka asiakas tekisi itse, mutta ei niistä vamman tai sairauden vuoksi selviä yksin. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on auttaa asiakasta jokapäiväisissä arjen tehtävissä niin kotona kuin myös kodin ulkopuolella.

Avustustehtävät ovat usein tavallisia arkisia askareita, joita me kaikki toteutamme myös omassa arjessamme. Avustajan työhön ei siten sisälly tehtäviä, jotka vaativat erillistä, esimerkiksi lähihoitajan tutkintoa, vaan kuka tahansa voi toimia avustajana. Avustustehtäviä ovat esimerkiksi asiakkaan avustaminen kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa, ruokailussa tai ruoanlaitossa, pukeutumisessa, harrastuksissa tai kodinhoidossa.

MILLAINEN HENKILÖ SOPII AVUSTAJAKSI?
Voimme useiden satojen henkilökohtaisten avustajien työnantajana todeta, että henkilökohtaisiksi avustajiksi sopivat parhaiten henkilöt, joilla on oikea asenne tärkeää avustamistyötä kohtaan. Avustajan on hyvä olla luotettava, positiivinen, avulias, ahkera ja ihmisläheinen henkilö.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aikaisempaa vastaavaa työkokemusta, sillä jokainen uusi avustaja perehdytetään kattavalla perehdytyksellä Aarre Avustajien omassa Aarre Akatemiassa ennen työn aloittamista. Avustamis- ja hoiva-alan kokemuksesta tai koulutuksesta voi kuitenkin olla hyötyä joidenkin asiakkaiden kohdalla.

MILLAISIA TYÖVUOROJA ON TARJOLLA JA VOINKO ITSE VAIKUTTAA NIIHIN?
Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, joka tapahtuu niin arkisin kuin myös viikonloppuisin ja mahdollisia työvuoroja on usein tarjolla aamusta iltaan. Aarre Avustajilla voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, miten paljon ja milloin haluat työskennellä sekä millaiselle asiakkaalle. Pyrimme yhdistämään asiakkaidemme avustajatarpeet ja avustajiemme työtoiveet niin, että ne sopivat kaikille. Saat aina tavata mahdollisen uuden asiakkaan ennen asiakassuhteen aloittamista, ja mikäli koet, että jokin asia ei toimi niin kuin ajattelit, voimme yhdessä etsiä sinulle sopivan vaihtoehdon. Meillä voit tehdä halutessasi avustajan töitä niin monelle asiakkaalle kuin itse haluat.

HAKEMINEN
Rekrytointimme on jatkuvaa, joten täytäthän työnhakulomakkeen tarkasti. Muista lisätä työnhakulomakkeeseen kaikki sinulle sopivat kunnat, joissa voit työskennellä, niin osaamme olla sinuun yhteydessä heti, kun löydämme sinulle sopivan asiakkaan. Työnhakulomakkeen täyttäminen ei vielä sido sinua mihinkään.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

title: Purchasing Specialist
description:
**About Sine Engineering**

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, including communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technology, and our solutions power many of today's active interceptor operations.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

**Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere.**

We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive **Purchasing Specialist** to develop and manage our Finland offices end-to-end procurement activities from creating purchase orders and validating supplier confirmations to ensuring timely deliveries and resolving shortages. You will maintain daily communication with suppliers, support onboarding and RFQ processes.

What we need is a strong procurement professional who will thrive in a global role with a lot of independence and responsibility, with the potential to grow into team leadership.

In this position you will be building the procurement process in Finland together with your international colleagues and manager. Your colleagues and stakeholders are spread across several countries, so you'll work in an international collaboration setup, but you will as well work closely with our Engineering and Finance teams, so you should have a good understanding of the Finnish procurement field.

With us you'll learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company. Because this is a key role in Finland, it is also an opportunity to develop something new, and a possibility grow into a leadership position.

**Location:** Tampere, on-site, fulltime, permanent position

**Key responsibilities**

- Create and manage purchase orders (POs) based on MRP, requisitions, or project needs


- Validate order confirmations: prices, delivery dates, quantities


- Follow up with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery


- Resolve delivery delays, shortages, and discrepancies.


- Follow up with warehouse team to have proper receiving within WH


- Maintain day-to-day communication with suppliers


- Support onboarding new suppliers by collecting documents and coordinating approval flows


- Request quotes (RFQs) and compare proposal


- Provide purchasing support during new product development (NPI)


- Support engineering changes (ECR/ECO) by updating suppliers and adjusting POs


**What we require**

To succeed in this role, you should have:

- Good knowledge of Finnish procurement process, limitations and constraints

- Good understanding of purchasing processes (RFQ, RFI, POs, contracts, and incoterms)

- Supplier management skills (evaluation, onboarding, performance tracking)


- Cost analysis skills like ability to compare quotes, calculate landed cost, evaluate TCO


- Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)


- Basic contract understanding like payment terms, delivery terms, warranty clauses etc.


- Strong ability to analyze prices, trends, and delivery performance


- Proficiency with Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation)


- Understanding demand planning and how it impacts purchasing


- English: B2 or higher


**What we see as a plus**

- Experience working at EMS factories

- Highly adaptable mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and solve problems beyond previous experience


**What We Offer**

**Paid Time Off**

The Employee is entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**

- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the taxfree limit as a fringe benefit.


- Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies.


- Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support.


- Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care.


- Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time.


- Business Travel Insurance: coverage for workrelated travel.


- Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks.


**Work Model**

- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00.


- NoCrunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed.


- MeetingLight Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings.


**Growth & Innovation**

- HighEnd Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals.


- Lab & Gadget Budget: annual budget for hardware, tools, books, and learning materials.


- Hackathons & Offsites: regular internal events focused on innovation and technology.


**Travel & Mobility**

- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation.


- Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum taxfree Vero rates.


**Impact & Culture**

- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement.


**Culture Statement**

Dont meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesnt perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.

Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.

**Privacy Notice**

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

Your data will be handled in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. We will retain your application data for up to 2 years, unless you consent to a longer retention period.

title: MORS Software : Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Type**: Full-time and permanent

**Location**: Helsinki, Aleksanterinkatu 48

**Application deadline**: 20.10.2026

**Looking for a role where you can take real ownership and help shape the next generation of business-critical fintech software?**

MORS Software develops Treasury Management and Asset & Liability Management software for banks. The product is evolving from a primarily desktop architecture toward a browser-based experience, a durable application/API layer and governed AI/agentic capabilities through MORSia.

Now, MORS is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to join its growing engineering team.

**What will you be doing?**

As a Senior Software Engineer at MORS, you will take end-to-end ownership of key areas of its treasury and banking software. Your work will be backend-focused, with C#/.NET at the core, and will combine work on established production systems with building new solutions. Roughly 60% of the work focuses on the existing product and architecture and 40% on new development.

Your initial focus will be on Financial Planning and Payments, where you will take ownership of existing functionality while contributing to their continued development. Over time, your scope may expand into other areas of MORSs banking software.

Ownership here means more than implementing predefined tickets. You will work with Product and domain specialists to understand the underlying business problem, design the solution, implement and test it, take it to production, investigate issues, and improve it further. You will also have room to challenge existing approaches and influence technical and architectural decisions together with MORS's CTO and engineering team. **What makes you a great fit?**

You are an experienced backend engineer who enjoys taking responsibility for complex software rather than focusing only on an isolated part of the development cycle. You can navigate an established codebase, make pragmatic technical decisions, and move work forward independently even when every requirement has not been defined upfront.

You do not need previous banking experience, but you should be interested in understanding why the software exists and what it enables for customers. MORS values engineers who communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and remain curious as development practices and technologies evolve.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 5 years of professional experience with C#/.NET and strong backend development skills

- Experience owning, debugging, and developing established production software and business-critical functionality

- Strong SQL Server and data access skills, combined with a good understanding of REST APIs and systems integration

- Experience with automated testing, source control, and CI/CD as part of professional software development

- Good English skills and the ability to plan work independently, identify dependencies, and communicate technical risks clearly


**Additional skills we value:**

title: Director of Human Resources
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking an experienced, strategic and highly collaborative HR leader to join our School Leadership Team and lead the development of people strategy and HR practice across the school.

This senior leadership role requires excellent professional knowledge with sound judgement, courage, discretion and exceptional interpersonal skills. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating complexity, providing trusted advice and constructive challenge, resolving conflict and leading sensitive and difficult conversations with clarity, empathy and confidence.

The Director of Human Resources builds trust and alignment while maintaining the professional independence necessary to provide clear HR advice, uphold organisational expectations and address challenging issues directly and constructively.

A strong understanding of employment law, collective agreements and the Finnish employment environment is important, together with the ability to lead strategically within a diverse international community.

**Key Responsibilities Include:**

- Lead the development and implementation of the schools HR strategy, ensuring that people practices, systems and structures support ISHs strategic priorities and mission.

- Partner closely with the Head of School and School Leadership Team, providing trusted advice, professional expertise and constructive challenge on workforce planning, organisational development and complex personnel matters.

- Drive continuous improvement in HR systems, policies and practices, identifying opportunities to strengthen organisational effectiveness, employee experience and accountability.

- Lead and oversee full-cycle recruitment, selection, onboarding and offboarding, ensuring rigorous, equitable and efficient processes aligned with school policies, safeguarding expectations and DEIJ principles.

- Lead performance and employee relations processes, including professional growth, workplace conflict, performance improvement, and disciplinary matters with clarity, empathy, and discretion.

- Build and sustain a culture of exceptional collaboration, trust and shared accountability, working across teams and perspectives to build alignment and address differences constructively.

- Ensure HR practices and decisions comply with Finnish employment legislation, applicable collective agreements, school policies and relevant regulatory requirements.

- Collaborate with the Director of Business and Operations and Head of School on compensation, benefits, leave and other employment conditions.

- Strengthen staff engagement and wellbeing through purposeful feedback mechanisms, effective communication and appropriate collaboration with occupational health services.

- Oversee employment contracts, absence procedures, HR digital systems, international recruitment and relocation procedures, and other key personnel processes.

- Champion the schools safeguarding culture through rigorous safer recruitment and HR practices, ensuring that employee-related safeguarding concerns are recognised, reported and addressed promptly in accordance with school procedures.


- Contribute actively as a member of the School Leadership Team, taking collective responsibility for whole-school priorities and helping to shape a positive, inclusive and high-performing organisational culture.


**What We Offer**

This senior leadership role offers a significant opportunity to shape ISHs people strategy, influence organisational culture and drive meaningful organisational development within a vibrant international learning community.

ISH offers competitive compensation and benefits and an environment in which professional expertise, initiative and leadership are valued. The successful candidate will have meaningful scope to influence organisational practice while working within a highly collaborative leadership culture built on trust, accountability, inclusion and shared responsibility.

**Salary:**

The salary will be commensurate with qualifications and relevant experience, in accordance with the ISH pay structure and applicable collective agreements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- A university degree in Human Resources, employment law, business administration, organisational leadership or another relevant field.

- Significant professional experience within an established HR function, preferably including senior or leadership responsibility.

- Strong knowledge of employment law and working knowledge of collective agreements and the legal environment relevant to schools in Finland.

- Experience in international, multicultural and/or educational environments.

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters, including performance concerns, workplace conflict and disciplinary processes.

- Confidence and capability to conduct difficult, courageous conversations and provide direct, constructive feedback.

- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to build trust, influence effectively, and collaborate across diverse teams while maintaining independent professional judgement.

- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and manage organisational and employment-related risk.

- Adaptability, resilience and the capacity to prioritise effectively in a dynamic and complex environment.

- High levels of integrity, discretion and commitment to confidentiality.

- Excellent competence in HR technology and digital tools.


**Child Protection & Safeguarding** ISH is committed to the highest standards of safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. Successful candidates will be required to sign the schools Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct and successfully complete appropriate background checks, including police clearance and reference verification.

**Employment Start Date**

- As soon as possible, ideally December 2026 and no later than January 2027.

title: Trädgårdsunderhåll Trädgårdmästare Trädgårdsarbetare
description:
Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Ni kan läsa mer om företaget och hur vi jobbar på vår hemsida www.jardinriviera.com

Vi behöver en morgonpigg, positiv och glad person som gillar att ta del av teamets kunskaper och vår service.

Du är proaktiv, ansvarstagande, har god lyssningsförmåga, visar nyfikenhet och är bra på att interagera och planera ditt arbete.

Vi letar efter dig som sätter ett värde i att utföra arbetet på bästa möjliga vis och som inte är rädd för att hugga i när och där det behövs.

För att lyckas och trivas i tjänsten behöver du vara serviceinriktad och ta ansvar för att hålla hög kvalitet i det arbete du utför.

Vi tror också att du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och att du har lätt för att samarbeta.

För oss är det viktigt att ha ett trevligt och glatt bemötande, både mot varandra såväl som kunderna samt att ha ett intresse för trädgårdar.

B-körkort är ett måste då vi använder bilar för att ta oss till våra kunder.

Du ska förutom svenska även kunna prata engelska då nästan all kommunikation sker på engelska, franska är självklart en bra merit.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Om detta kan vara av intresse, lägg en mail till oss på info@jardinriviera.com där du berättar om dig själv samt erfarenhet osv.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! ☀️🌴

Jardin Riviera

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

description:

Expert reconnu de votre métier et des produits, très à l'écoute des nouvelles tendances de consommation, vous gérez votre périmètre de manière autonome en relation avec votre hiérarchie.

description: Au sein d'un Service de Soins Infirmiers À Domicile (SSIAD) partenaire, vous intervenez directement au domicile des patients (personnes âgées, personnes en situation de handicap ou atteintes de pathologies chroniques) :-Assurer les soins d'hygiène, de confort et de bien-être au quotidien.-Accompagner les patients dans les actes de la vie courante en favorisant leur maintien à domicile.-Observer et surveiller l'état général des patients et transmettre les informations à l'infirmier(e) coordinateur(trice).-Créer une relation de confiance avec le patient et son entourage.

title: Responsable Génie des Procédés F/H - CAYENNE
description: Le mouton à 5 pattes, cabinet de recrutement, recherche pour un groupe industriel international spécialisé dans la conception et la réalisation de solutions techniques sur mesure, son/sa futur(e) Responsable Génie des Procédés F/H.Vous êtes un expert du Génie des Procédés, mais aimez également transformer un besoin industriel en une solution concrète, accompagner vos équipes et échanger directement avec vos clients ? Nous recherchons ici un profil capable de conjuguer expertise technique, management et vision projet.MISSIONS :Rattaché à la Direction, vous prenez la responsabilité d'une activité d'ingénierie Process et accompagnez des projets industriels depuis l'analyse du besoin jusqu'à leur réalisation.À la tête d'une équipe technique pluridisciplinaire, vous intervenez à la fois comme manager, référent métier et interlocuteur privilégié des équipes projets.Vos principales responsabilités seront de :Analyser les problématiques industrielles des clients et définir les orientations techniques permettant d'y répondre ;Concevoir et valider les principes de procédés, bilans, dimensionnements et choix d'équipements associés ;Piloter les études de faisabilité et sécuriser la pertinence technique des solutions proposées ;Apporter votre expertise lors des phases amont des projets et participer à la construction des propositions techniques et économiques ;Manager et accompagner une équipe d'ingénieurs et techniciens, organiser les priorités et favoriser la montée en compétences ;Superviser les études d'ingénierie et garantir la cohérence des choix réalisés jusqu'aux phases de réalisation ;Piloter les essais nécessaires à la validation ou à l'optimisation des procédés et exploiter les résultats pour fiabiliser les solutions industrielles ;Accompagner les phases clés des projets, notamment lors des revues techniques, essais de performance et mises en service ;Développer les méthodes, capitaliser les retours d'expérience et contribuer à l'évolution des technologies et savoir-faire de l'activité ;Entretenir une relation technique de haut niveau avec les clients et partenaires, en France comme à l'international.Vous occupez ainsi une fonction particulièrement transverse : vous ne quittez pas la technique pour manager, mais prenez de la hauteur pour orienter les choix, faire progresser les équipes et porter les solutions auprès des clients.Pour en savoir plus cliquez ici : Cliquez ici

Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Jardin Riviera

Marketing Manager – Marchés francophones (H/F/D)

CDI – Temps partiel ou temps plein

Poste basé à Paris (Télétravail possible)

Vos missions

- Piloter et développer les activités marketing sur le marché francophone, en adaptant la stratégie marketing internationale aux besoins et spécificités locales.
- Développer la visibilité et la notoriété de SOFiSTiK auprès des publics cibles, notamment à travers LinkedIn, le site web et des campagnes digitales.

- Créer, adapter et optimiser les contenus marketing en français : contenus web, newsletters, brochures, campagnes, témoignages clients et autres supports.
- Planifier et coordonner les webinaires, salons et événements destinés aux marchés francophones, de la conception à la promotion et au suivi.
- Analyser les performances des actions marketing et identifier les leviers permettant d'améliorer leur impact et leur contribution aux objectifs commerciaux.
- Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Marketing internationale du siège afin d'adapter les campagnes, contenus et initiatives globales au marché francophone.
- Être l'interface Marketing avec les équipes commerciales et les autres parties prenantes locales, afin d'identifier les besoins du marché et de soutenir le développement commercial.

Profil recherché

- Formation supérieure en marketing, communication, médias ou domaine équivalent.
- 3 ans minimum d’expérience professionnelle en marketing, idéalement dans un environnement B2B, en entreprise ou en agence.
- Esprit analytique et orientation résultats, avec une capacité à suivre les performances des actions marketing et à identifier des pistes d’optimisation
- Capacité à piloter des actions marketing de manière autonome, de leur conception à leur mise en œuvre et à l’analyse des résultats.
- Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et sensibilité aux contenus et à la communication digitale.
- Expérience et forte appétence pour les campagnes digitales, les réseaux sociaux et l’organisation d’événements/webinaires.
- Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et bonne compréhension des enjeux de génération et de gestion des leads.
- Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec de très bonnes qualités rédactionnelles.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral (niveau B2 minimum), permettant de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international.  
- La connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout.
- La connaissance d’outils CRM et/ou de marketing automation (Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, etc.) constitue un atout.

Vos qualités

- Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets et priorités simultanément
- Excellent relationnel et aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement international.
- Esprit d'équipe, curiosité et proactivité.

Ce que nous proposons

- Un rôle varié et autonome, avec la possibilité de prendre des initiatives, de proposer vos idées et de contribuer concrètement au développement de SOFiSTiK sur le marché francophone.
- Un accompagnement structuré dès votre arrivée, pour vous familiariser avec nos solutions, notre marché et nos équipes.
- Un environnement de travail international, collaboratif et à taille humaine, avec des échanges réguliers avec les équipes Marketing et commerciales en France et à l’international.
- Des possibilités de formation et de développement professionnel, en fonction de votre expérience et de vos ambitions.
- Une organisation favorisant l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, avec des horaires flexibles et la possibilité de télétravailler selon les modalités en vigueur.
- Une rémunération attractive complétée par des avantages sociaux (mutuelle, …).

jobs@sofistik.com

Nous étudierons votre candidature avec attention et reviendrons vers vous dans les meilleurs délais afin d'échanger ensemble sur votre parcours et vos motivations.

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Tu sais aussi prendre de la hauteur, construire une stratégie et accompagner une équipe dans sa performance.


Tu maîtrises les enjeux MICE, Groupes et Corporate , tu comprends les logiques de Revenue Management et tu sais travailler de manière fluide avec les équipes Marketing.


Tu es autonome, structuré(e), orienté(e) résultats et capable de passer naturellement d'un sujet stratégique à une problématique très opérationnelle.


Tu es à l'aise en anglais et tu as envie de prendre une place active dans l'écosystème économique lillois Pourquoi nous rejoindre.

Pour prendre la responsabilité commerciale d'un cluster de 8 hôtels aux enseignes fortes et complémentaires Pour occuper un rôle qui combine réellement stratégie, management et vente directe Pour travailler au cœur d'un environnement en transformation, avec des projets de repositionnement et d'évolution de marques.


Pour collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes Commerciales, Revenue, Marketing, Direction et Opérationnelles du Groupe.


Et surtout, pour avoir un impact direct sur le développement de WiZiU et de ses hôtels sur la place lilloise Tes avantages

- Bénéficiez d'une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 60 Profitez du bénéfice des jours fériés dès 6 mois d'ancienneté chez WiZiU.
- Recevez une prime WiZconnect grâce à vos recommandations.
- Recevez la prime WiZtrust pour récompenser votre fidélité.
- Profitez de possibilités d'évolution au sein du Groupe.
- Bénéficiez du programme WiZdiscount avec des remises exclusives dans les hôtels, restaurants et SPA du Groupe WiZiU.


Chez WiZiU, chaque stratégie, chaque relation client et chaque opportunité transformée participent au développement de nos hôtels.


Derrière la performance d'un cluster, il y a aussi un(e) Directeur Commercial(e) capable de donner une direction, d'embarquer les équipes et de rester connecté(e) au terrain Salaire : 65 à 70K€ annuel + 15% variable.

Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Rejoignez Safran Aerosystems : leader international dans la sécurité aéronautique, la gestion des fluides et du carburant. Notre force ? Innover pour la sécurité des vols (oxygène, évacuation, flottabilité) et piloter la transition vers une aviation décarbonée grâce aux carburants durables. 6 200 collaborateurs, 7 pays et un seul objectif : un ciel plus sûr.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionSummary of Duties:

o Responsible for achieving customer satisfaction which is measured through Airframer & Internal Scorecards

o Building new and developing long-lasting relationships with customers

o Operate as the focal point for all matters specific to their customers

o Taking ownership of customers issues and following problems through to resolution

o Responsible for keeping accurate records and documenting customer support actions and discussions within CRM platform

o Perform on-site customer meetings as required ie Program Review Meetings (PRM),

Technical Review Meeting (TRM), and Executive Review Meetings (ERM) etc.

o Generate post visit reports and manage actions and commitments through to completion

o Generate Key Performance Indicators (KPI's)

o Analyze data to identify trends and areas of improvements

o Serve as the focal for performance claims: coordinate with warranty teams to validate claim data, negotiate settlement with customer, track claims

o Support SCS Finance department in the recovery of late AR helping finance with the right POCs and addressing systemic/ repetitive issues for corrective actions.

o Awareness of customers internal issues which may affect the Safran Cabin Services business

o Feedback information to Safran Cabin Service sales team on new sales opportunities and Program teams on at-risk parts: PMA, Owner Operator Parts

o Awareness of customer support contractual obligations either through the Airframer contracts or specific contracts with a specific customer

o Support Field Technical Representatives performing cabin inspections and generating the associated reports

o Provide level 1 & 2 technical support using CMM's & technical drawings data

o Support STC working parties as required, support Entry into service (EIS) for new aircraft types

o Being available in accordance with constraints linked to aftermarket support domain

title: Planificateur de maintenance (H/F)
description:
L'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) d'Amazon est le garant de la performance opérationnelle de nos sites. En tant que Planificateur de Maintenance, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique au cœur de notre réseau. Vous serez l'expert(e) de la planification et de l'optimisation de nos ressources de maintenance, en anticipant les besoins avant qu'ils ne deviennent des problèmes.

Basé(e) sur l'un de nos sites opérationnels, vous maîtriserez notre système de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO) et assurerez la disponibilité optimale de nos équipements dans un environnement dynamique et innovant.

Key job responsibilities
- Excellence en sécurité: Garantir la conformité de tous les équipements aux normes européennes de sécurité. Planifier les maintenances préventives pour éliminer les risques avant qu'ils ne surviennent.
- Excellence opérationnelle: Optimiser l'allocation des ressources de maintenance via notre logiciel GMAO. Analyser en continu les performances des équipements et ajuster les niveaux de stock de pièces détachées. Assurer la fiabilité des données de maintenance et la précision des prévisions.
- Innovation & Amélioration Continue: Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des processus de maintenance. Collaborer avec le réseau européen RME pour partager les meilleures pratiques.

Qualifications De Base
- Expérience préalable dans la planification et l'audit d'activités de maintenance ; créations de gammes de maintenance
- Maîtrise d'un logiciel GMAO
- Expérience en gestion d'inventaires de pièces détachées
- Bonne maîtrise de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Maîtrise de l'anglais (CEFR C1 ou supérieur, écrit et oral)

Qualifications Appréciées
- Compréhension des systèmes de contrôle basés sur des automates et des exigences de conformité statutaire
- Expérience de l'utilisation de systèmes informatisés de gestion de la maintenance pour planifier la maintenance et consigner les tâches
- Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes

description:

- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats

- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

description:
