title: Position(s) as Associate Professor in Accounting
description:
About the position

Oslo Business School is a relatively new business school (founded in 2014) focusing on teaching quality and excellence in research. The school has currently about 2000 students and 80 employees and offers study programs at Bachelor, Master, and PhD level. The Finance and Accounting group, one of the school’s five sections, is a vibrant and diverse group consisting of researchers that regularly publish in recognized international journals. Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods
description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for a postdoctoral research fellow in numerical mathematics for a period of 3 years.
 
About the postdoctoral project:

The postdoctoral position is part of the project “Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods for Two-Phase Flow” (PANum) funded by the Research Council of Norway. The project is a joint collaboration between Western Norway University of Applied Sciences and Hasselt University in Belgium.

In PANum the goal is to formulate and implement mathematical methods that are not only robust, efficient and have a low numerical error, but that also guarantee that important physical properties are fulfilled in the numerical solution. Ultimately, PANum will lead to a computational algorithm that reliably simulates two-phase flow.

The postdoctoral project will be part of developing and analyzing relevant numerical methods and implement them in an open-source framework that will be made openly available for others to use. This will be relevant for example for CO2 storage and design of fuel cells. 


Research environment:

The PANum project is situated in the Engineering Computing research group at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and in the computational mathematics group (CMAT) at Hasselt University. Both groups focus strongly on numerical analysis and mathematical modelling. The prospective postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with Carina Bringedal and Erlend Storvik from Engineering Computing, Jochen Schütz from CMAT, as well as the current PhD and master students connected to the PANum project.

 

Postdoctoral research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is campus Bergen or campus Førde. 


Qualifications:

Criteria for appointment to the position of postdoctoral fellow are regulated in Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.

Applicants must have earned a PhD degree in computer science, simulation science, applied mathematics or in a closely related field, or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded within 6 weeks after the application deadline. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs.

 

A solid background in both the following fields is required:

  • Numerical analysis for ODEs and PDEs
  • Scientific programming using Python, MATLAB, C++, Julia, or similar

Furthermore, experience within:

  • collaborative code development and usage of version control tools like git
  • asymptotic methods, like two-scale asymptotic expansions or matched asymptotic expansions, for PDEs

will be considered an advantage when candidates are ranked. 

In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated:

  • Quality and relevance of PhD thesis
  • Quality and relevance of publications
  • Ability to work in intersection of theoretical and applied research
  • Ability to collaborate, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Oral and written good communication skills in English.

 

Career plan:

The person appointed shall, together with the institute, prepare a career plan that specifies the skills the postdoctoral researcher is to acquire. Competence goals shall be set both for the postdoctoral project and for any other career‑advancing work included in the position. The postdoctoral researcher will have access to career guidance.


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation should be uploaded as an attachment to the online application: 

  • A brief cover letter (max one page) including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
  • PhD thesis
  • Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees. If you have not yet been awarded your PhD degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the submission of the PhD thesis.
  • Copies of up to 5 selected academic publications
  • Names and contact details of 2 references (names, relation to candidate, email and telephone number).

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. 

 

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

 

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

 

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

 

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.


Salary and benefits:

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment.


An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position as postdoctoral researcher is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.


There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte"). Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences therefore aims to achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons with diverse backgrounds.

Information about the applicants may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications.


Contacts:

1) Professor Carina Bringedal, project leader of PANum

phone: +47 55 58 79 76, e-mail: carina.bringedal@hvl.no 

2) Associate Professor Therese B. Sjursen, assistant department leader

phone: +47 97 14 46 69 , e-mail: Therese.Berge.Sjursen@hvl.no 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners.

title: Kombinert utleierepresentant
description:
Arbeidssted: Aker brygge/Helsfyr
Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, helg, kveld)
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Oppstart: Etter avtale

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av service. Logistikk, kundeservice, salg og klargjøring er kjernen i hverdagen.

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygge Norges beste bilutleiekjede.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har førerkort klasse B

  • Du har plettfri vandel (politiattest kreves)

  • Du er serviceinnstilt og god med mennesker

  • Du trives med salg

  • Du arbeider strukturert og håndterer logistikk effektivt i en hektisk og stadig skiftende arbeidshverdag.

  • Du behersker norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du har gode datakunnskaper, gjerne Microsoft Office

Hva tilbyr vi?

Hos Sixt blir du en del av et selskap som vokser, og som vet at gode kundeopplevelser starter med dyktige medarbeidere.

• En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag sentralt i Oslo sentrum
• Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger
• Grundig opplæring og tydelige rammer
• Reelle utviklingsmuligheter for den som vil mer

Klar for å bli en del av Sixt? Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende, søk i dag.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

title: Vi søker utleieansvarlig til vår avdeling i Bergen
description:
Ramudden Norge AS er en helhetsleverandør innen sikkerhet på arbeidsplassen, med spesialkompetanse på løsninger for trafikkerte miljøer. Vi leverer utstyr, tjenester og kunnskap som bidrar til å skape trygge arbeidsplasser hver eneste dag.  

Vi ser nå etter en engasjert og dyktig kollega til et ettårig vikariat ved vår avdeling i Bergen. Vi ønsker å få vår nye kollega på plass så snart som mulig, og for den rette kandidaten kan det også være muligheter videre etter endt vikariat.

Som utleieansvarlig får du en variert arbeidshverdag der kundekontakt, utleie og koordinering går hånd i hånd med praktiske oppgaver på lageret. Du blir en viktig del av den daglige driften, og vi ser etter deg som liker å ta ansvar, holde oversikt og bidra til god flyt i en tidvis hektisk hverdag. Samtidig er du en lagspiller som samarbeider godt med de rundt deg og har sikkerhet og kvalitet i fokus.

 

Hva vil du jobbe med?  

De viktigste arbeidsoppgavene dine: 

  • Mottak, lasting og lossing av varer
  • Plukking, pakking og klargjøring av utstyr til prosjekter
  • Sørge for god orden og struktur på lageret
  • Ansvar for utleie, inkludert oppfølging av kunder, sjekklister og fakturering
  • Samhandle med kolleger, sjåfører og øvrige avdelinger
  • Daglig bruk av truck og hjullaster
  • Montering av varsling og sikringsutstyr ved arbeid på og langs vei

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar og har evne til å holde oversikt i en variert og tidvis hektisk arbeidshverdag. Du følger opp oppgaver, prioriterer når det er mye som skjer og trives med å koordinere arbeidet på lageret.

Hos oss er samarbeid en viktig del av hverdagen. Vi håper derfor du er en kollega som bidrar positivt, hjelper til der det trengs og er opptatt av å skape en god arbeidshverdag sammen med menneskene rundt deg.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Er selvgående og løsningsorientert
  • Trives i dialog med både kunder og kolleger
  • Har et tydelig fokus på sikkerhet i arbeidshverdagen

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Kompetansebevis M4 – Hjullaster
  • Gyldig truckførerbevis T1-T4
  • Bestå APV 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse)
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Er komfortabel med bruk av digitale verktøy i arbeidshverdagen

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring fra lignende rolle eller relevant bransje
  • Førerkort klasse BE og CE

 

Hvorfor velge oss?

Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger som samarbeider godt, deler kunnskap og har det hyggelig sammen på jobb. Du får en variert rolle med ansvar og mulighet til å bli en viktig del av den daglige driften ved avdelingen og bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid på og langs veiene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med hjelpsomme og trivelige kollegaer
  • En trygg arbeidsplass i et selskap som setter kvalitet og sikkerhet først

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

 

Søknadsfrist: 30.10.26 – Vi vurderer søknader og tar kontakt med aktuelle kandidater fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

Alle har relevant erfaring og bidrar med et stort nettverk.

title: Researcher position in Early Earth Processes
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position in Early Earth Processes, available at the Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB), Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, University of Oslo (UiO).

The position is a full-time position for a period of 3 years.

Starting date no later than 01.01.2027.

Place of work is PHAB, the Department of Geosciences at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is associated with PHAB and linked to the research theme ‘Planets and Early Earth’, which addresses planet formation, evolution and comparative planetology to identify the initial conditions for habitability and how a planet’s composition and interior influence its ability to nurture a biosphere. The researcher will be part of a project group that explore the conditions for early life and Earth’s evolution as a habitable planet, and specifically, through geochemical investigations of ancient cratons and greenstone belts to understand habitable environments and key geological events (e.g., the Great Oxidation Event) to shed light on crustal and atmospheric processes during Archean-Paleoproterozoic times. The project requires considerable field and laboratory experience, and we seek a candidate with a strong Archean-Paleoproterozoic geological background with a proven record in early Earth surface processes, sedimentology, geobiology, micropaleontology, evolutionary processes, geochemistry and geochronology.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in geosciences. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Strong publication track record.
  • Extensive Archean craton and greenstone belt field experience.
  • Early Earth geobiological research background using stable isotope systematics (C, N, S, O) and Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS).
  • Experience with U-Pb zircon geochronology and Lu-Hf isotopic systematics.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience working in large-scale multi-partner projects.
  • Experience in paleo sea-temperature proxies and pH modelling of oceans.
  • Experience in advanced methods, e.g. high-resolution synchrotron-based techniques.  
  • Experience in fundraising.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 646000 to 745000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Your Project Vision (1 page) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity) 
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB) is a Norwegian Centre of Excellence that provides a stimulating and well-funded research environment. PHAB’s main goal, based on detailed studies of Earth and our solar system, is to develop predictive models to identify habitable planets around other stars. The centre was established in 2023 and will consist of approximately 70 full time and part time professors and researchers, PhD Research Fellows and Postdoctoral Research Fellows.

Main responsibilities include:

title: Vil du lede et driftsteknikerteam med varierte og spennende arbeidsdager?
description:
I Coop Øst er det stor aktivitet, og spesielt i vår avdeling for butikk- og eiendomsutvikling skjer det mye. Vår driftstekniker og innleide vaktmestere har ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen våre 52 egeneiende eiendommer. For å møte veksten og den økte aktiviteten søker vi nå en teamleder.

Som teamleder vil du få ansvar for eget team med driftsteknikere/innleide vaktmestere, samtidig som du har ansvar for egen eiendomsportefølje på lik linje med de øvrige driftsteknikerne. Rollen passer for deg som trives med å kombinere praktisk og operativ eiendomsdrift med faglig oppfølging, planlegging, koordinering og teamlederansvar.

Butikk- og eiendomsutvikling i Coop Øst har ansvar for forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre butikker og eiendommer. Avdelingen teller 16 engasjerte ansatte med lang fartstid i bedriften, og det er 82 ansatte på hovedkontoret totalt. Per i dag forvalter Coop Øst ca. 287 000 m² eiendom med butikkdrift. Vi eier 52 eiendommer med butikkdrift (totalt 100 500 m²) som skal forvaltes og utvikles. Som teamleder for driftsteknikerne blir du en sentral bidragsyter i å sikre god struktur, effektiv ressursbruk og høy kvalitet i den operative eiendomsdriften.

Søknadsfrist: 20.10.2026
Søkere vurderes fortløpende.

Hva skal du gjøre?
Som teamleder vil du både jobbe med egen portefølje og ha et tydelig teamlederansvar for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere. Du vil følge opp teamet og bidra til god planlegging og koordinering, samtidig som du sikrer at oppgaver prioriteres og løses på en strukturert måte. Rollen innebærer praktisk arbeid ute på eiendommene og daglig drift og tilsyn. Du vil ha oppfølging av tekniske anlegg, følge opp eksterne leverandører og serviceavtaler, samt gi bistand ved ombygginger, oppgraderinger og prosjekter. I tillegg vil du være en tydelig faglig ressurs og koordinator for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere, bidra til god fremdrift i oppgavene og sørge for at avdelingen har oversikt over status, behov og prioriteringer. Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å bidra til sikker, kostnadseffektiv og forutsigbar drift av eiendommene, samtidig som du skaper gode rammer for teamet ditt.

Coop Øst har hovedkontor på Kolbotn og eget lager for verktøy og utstyrrett i nærheten. Du må påregne reisevirksomhet mellom våre ulike eiendommer. Dette er en selvstendig og mobil rolle hvor du primært vil jobbe ute med egen eiendomsportefølje og samtidig skal bidra til å planlegge, koordinere og følge opp arbeidsoppgavene i teamet.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har yrkesfaglig bakgrunn, gjerne som tømrer, elektriker eller rørlegger eller er driftstekniker i dag. 
  • Det er en fordel med erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold av næringseiendom.
  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Førerkort klasse BE er påkrevd for stillingen. Kandidater som ikke har BE ved ansettelse må være villige til å gjennomføre og bestå førerprøven for klasse BE innen avtalt tid.
  • Det er viktig med gode samarbeidsevner og at du trives med en utadrettet og selvstendig arbeidshverdag.
  • I Coop Øst er vi opptatt av et godt arbeidsmiljø og det å være serviceinnstilt over dine kollegaer og våre samarbeidspartnere legger vi stor vekt på.
  • For god og grundig utførelsen av denne jobben er viktig å være strukturert og løsningsorientert


Hva kan du få hos oss?
Coop Øst er et fremoverlent samvirkelag hvor det skjer mye. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ansatte og legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs hos oss. Du kommer inn i et godt onboardingsprogram og vil oppleve at hovedkontoret består av mange serviceinnstilte og hjelpsomme kollegaer. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, telefonordning, arbeidsbil, helseforsikring og tilgang til firmahytter får du også. Som medeier og ansatt i Coop Øst får du 6% ansattrabatt/kjøpeutbytte. Ikke minst vil du få mange engasjerte og skikkelig dyktige kollegaer og jobb i et solid selskap. Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg i Coop Øst. 

Coop Øst bruker sertifiserte arbeidspsykologiske testverktøy fra Assessio i rekrutteringsprosessen.
Vi benytter SEMAC bakgrunnssjekk på aktuelle kandidater.

Hvis dette er noe for deg gleder vi oss til å se eller lese søknaden din:-)

Kundene våre gjenspeiler befolkingen og det vil vi at våre ansatte også skal gjøre. Vi er opptatt av mangfold og ønsker alle søkere velkommen, uansett bakgrunn, erfaring, funksjonsevne, kjønn, legning eller religion. Coop Øst ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver for alle.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Coop Øst SA er Norges største samvirkelag med en omsetning på 10,2 milliarder i 2025. Vi har ca. 4400 ansatte og 211 butikker i de 5 fylkene Østfold, Akershus, Oslo, Buskerud og Innlandet med hovedkontor på Kolbotn i Nordre Follo. Coop har 6 kjedekonsepter; Coop Prix, Coop Mega, EXTRA, Matkroken, Obs og Obs BYGG. Coop er den eneste aktøren innen detaljhandel som er eid av forbrukerne og baserer sin drift på delingsøkonomi og utbytte til alle medeiere. Coop er opptatt av bærekraft, og omtanke for mennesker, dyr og miljø blir stadig viktigere for oss. Derfor jobber vi kontinuerlig med å redusere vår klima- og miljøpåvirkning. Vi har blant annet en nullvisjon for kasting av mat og fokus på bærekraftige produkter. For å lese mer se www.coop.no/coop-og-barekraft

title: Join us in our mission to find new ways of protecting neurons from neurodegeneration!
description:
About the position

We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team at the Department of Microbiology, at the Institute of Clinical Medicine at the University of Oslo. The position will be associated with the young research group “Mitonuclear DNA Maintenance and Transcriptional Control“ and will be working on the Research Council of Norway funded research project “MIND: Mitochondria-Initiated Neuronal Defense against Parkinson’s Disease”.

The position is for 2 years, from 1st of January 2027. Start date is negotiable.


More about the position

This position offers a unique opportunity to help uncover how DNA repair and mitochondrial transcription shape neuronal resilience in Parkinson’s disease. You will be the main experimental researcher of Work Package 2, where we develop and apply a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) based model of midbrain dopaminergic neurons and midbrain organoids. Using patient-derived iPSCs carrying an alpha-synuclein (SNCA) triplication and isogenic controls, you will investigate how loss of DNA repair enzymes alters mitochondrial transcription, alpha-syn aggregation, and neuronal survival.

The project explores a new idea in Parkinson’s disease (PD): that certain types of DNA repair deficiency can activate protective mitochondrial and transcriptional responses in neurons, rather than only causing damage. We focus on the DNA base excision repair (BER) enzymes and how their loss affects mitochondrial function, α-synuclein aggregation, and survival of dopaminergic neurons.

You will be employed at the Department of Microbiology, which is jointly affiliated with the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital. The institute hosts a strong but very social environment, with access to advanced core facilities. The research section in the department has 15 research groups and 6 project groups (https://www.ous-research.no/microbiology/) working in various fields, including brain cancer, microbiology, epigenetics causes of disease, as well as groups focusing on bioinformatics.

The department will be located in the new life science building from January 2027 located near Forskningsparken with easy access by public transport (metro, tram, and bus), bicycle routes. You will work in an international, interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration across research groups in Oslo and with our partners at the University of Edinburgh.


Why we are seeking a researcher

Parkinson’s disease is one of the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disorders worldwide, yet current treatments are not disease-modifying. The MIND project challenges the traditional view that mitochondrial DNA damage is purely detrimental and explores how specific DNA repair defects may activate protective transcriptional programs in neurons. We are seeking a researcher who can take a leading experimental role in WP2: to establish and characterize our human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron model and to dissect how DNA repair-dependent changes in mitochondrial and nuclear transcription contribute to neuroprotection against alpha-syn–induced stress.

You will work closely with the principal investigator Dr. Nicola Pietro Montaldo, Prof. Hilde Loge Nilsen (UiO/OUH), and Prof. Tilo Kunath (University of Edinburgh).

If you are excited by the idea of discovering new neuronal self-defense programs, reshaping how we think about DNA repair and mitochondrial stress in Parkinson’s disease, and contributing to future therapeutic strategies, we encourage you to apply.


Your main tasks will be

Culture of iPSCs and Dopaminergic neurons:

  • Establish differentiation protocol for human neuronal cultures
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC-derived midbrain progenitors into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Validate neuronal identity and midbrain/dopaminergic markers using immunocytochemistry and RT-qPCR

Model Parkinson’s disease in vitro:

  • Work with a defined panel of iPSC lines: A patient line with SNCA (α-synuclein) triplication (high α-syn levels and aggregation) Isogenic SNCA-corrected controls (reduced or no α-syn expression).Lines with BER knockout on the SNCA triplication background
  • Measure α-syn and phospho-α-syn (pSer129) levels and aggregation (Western blot, ELISA, immunofluorescence)
  • Use seed amplification assays to investigate spreading of misfolded α-syn species
  • Assess mitochondrial function and stress responses
  • Measure mitochondrial respiration (OCR), ATP production and responses to mitochondrial stressors such as MPP+
  • Analyze mitochondrial DNA integrity and basic nuclear DNA damage responses
  • Contribute to transcriptional and data-driven analyses
  • Prepare samples for RNA-seq and other omics readouts
  • Work with the PI and collaborators on basic analysis and interpretation of differential gene expression and pathway changes.

Functional readouts of neuronal health:

  •  Use microelectrode array (MEA) recordings (Maestro Pro Platform) to monitor neuronal network activity and relate this to α-syn load and mitochondrial status.

What you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and state-of-the-art PD models
  • Training in mitochondrial biology, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation in neurons
  • Access to advanced infrastructure (imaging, MEA, sequencing, high-performance computing)
  • Close collaboration with leading groups in DNA repair (Nilsen), PD/iPSC modeling (Kunath), and a growing national BER network (BER Norway)
  • Opportunities to co-author publications and present your work at national and international meetings.

What skills are important in this role?

 Required qualifications:

  • A PhD (or equivalent) in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biotechnology, or a closely related field
  • Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and standard sterile techniques, including primary cells, neuronal progenitor cells, and/or 3D/organoid cultures
  • Solid competence in core molecular and cell biology methods, such as: DNA / RNA extraction, PCR / qPCR / RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry / immunocytochemistry / immunofluorescence with associated fluorescence microscopy
  • Experience with multicolor flow cytometry and functional cellular or immune assays
  • Hands-on experience preparing high-quality samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), ideally including single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq) from complex tissues, together with standard quality-control metrics (e.g. Qubit, TapeStation)
  • Experience coordinating wet-lab work with bioinformatics and sequencing core facilities, and developing, optimizing, and documenting laboratory workflows
  • Experience with human iPSC-derived models, midbrain organoids, and/or neuronal differentiation (dopaminergic or other CNS lineages preferred
  • Good understanding of experimental design, protocol development and optimization, data documentation, reproducibility, and basic statistical analysis
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to work independently at the bench while coordinating effectively with principal investigators, bioinformaticians, core facilities, and collaborators.

Desired qualifications:
It is an advantage if you have one or more of the following:

  • Background in DNA repair, transcription, or chromatin biology
  • Experience supervising or training junior researchers or students
  • Experience with neurodegeneration models, especially:
    •  Parkinson’s disease
    • α-synuclein biology (expression, aggregation, or toxicity assays)   
  • Experience with mitochondrial biology, e.g.: 
    • Measuring oxygen consumption rate (OCR) or related metabolic assays
    • Working with mitochondrial toxins
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics / scripting (R, Python, or similar)
  • Microelectrode array (MEA) or other electrophysiological recordings (an advantage, not a requirement)
  • Flexibility to work on weekends when necessary to support cell culture work.

Meeting the required criteria is essential; the desired qualifications and personal skills will be used to distinguish between otherwise well-qualified candidates.


Personal skills 

In this role, you should:

  • Be curious, motivated, and scientifically engaged, with a strong interest in neurodegeneration and molecular mechanisms
  • Work systematically and reliably, with attention to detail and reproducibility
  • Be proactive in troubleshooting and optimizing protocols
  • Communicate clearly and openly, sharing results and challenges with the team
  • Enjoy working in an interdisciplinary and international environment and collaborating across groups and institute.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.


More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage

Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour

The relevance of the PhD to the project should also be documented. The reference list is not included in the page limit

title: Researcher on Global Maternal Health
description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a three-year researcher position (80%) at the Institute of Health and Society as part of a Global Health research project, "Preventing Severe Hypertensive Adverse Events in Pregnancy and Childbirth" (PRESHA). The position is part of a new Norwegian Research Council-funded project (Research Projects for Scientific Renewal – Global Health) led by Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg at the University of Oslo. Intended starting date for the position is Autumn 2026. 

The appointment is a part-time 80% position and is made for a period of up to three years. The researcher will work closely with Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.

The candidate is welcome to participate in building a long-term research program with particular emphasis on thematic areas fitting within a broader perspective on global women’s health across the life course.


More about the project

The PRESHA project is an ambitious project that aims to prevent maternal and perinatal death and disability due to pre-eclampsia in low-resource settings through improved prediction, prevention and clinical management. The project takes place in Mwanza, Tanzania. The official project period is from 2023-2028. The project partners are from Norway, Tanzania and the Netherlands. The project is unique in that it combines the introduction of biomarker PlGF/Sflt-1 for pre-eclampsia prediction with strengthening the organization of existing care processes. We will use a combination of disciplines and innovative methodological approaches to explore existing implementation challenges and co-create, implement and evaluate a package of interventions for prevention and management of pre-eclampsia that is adapted and relevant to the Tanzanian context.

For more information about the project, or further inquiries about the position please contact Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.


Your main tasks will be: 

The researcher will have a central role in the implementation phase of PRESHA, while also conducting analyses of cohort data. Key responsibilities include:

Research position

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of the implementation phase in close collaboration with partners in Tanzania, the Netherlands and Norway.
  • Organize and support implementation of the PRESHA quality-of-care package (PRESHA-QoC), including training, supervision, co-creation workshops and audit cycles.
  • Coordinate the stepped-wedge implementation of biomarker-based risk prediction (PRESHA‑TRIAL) across participating facilities.
  • Oversee timelines, documentation, reporting, ethics renewals and regulatory requirements related to the implementation phase.
  • Facilitate communication between clinical teams, research staff, community partners and the international study group.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance, protocol adherence and monitoring of implementation processes.
  • Analyze cohort data related to the social determinants of health and their impact on outcomes related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
  • Lead and co-author scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to methodological innovation in implementation research.
  • Work closely with the PI and team on developing and writing research grant applications (e.g. for project extension, new related studies).

Engage in dissemination, policy briefs and knowledge translation activities towards Tanzanian and international stakeholders.


Qualification requirements 

Qualification requirements

  • A PhD (or equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree) in global health, public health, epidemiology, medical sciences, social sciences with strong health focus, or a closely related field. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved.
  • Documented experience with mixed-methods research (both quantitative and qualitative).
  • Strong skills in quantitative analysis, preferably including:
    • cohort or longitudinal data analysis
    • regression modelling
    • handling of routine health dataexperience with statistical software (e.g. Stata, R, or similar).
  • Experience with qualitative methods (e.g. interviews, focus groups, observations) in health research.
  • Demonstrated interest in or experience with implementation research, quality improvement or health systems research.
  • Familiarity with maternal health, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, or related fields in global women’s health.
  • Familiarity with the thematic areas of the project and the complexity of maternal health is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.

Desired qualifications

  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language and/or Kiswahili would be an asset.
  • Previous experience working East Africa/sub-Saharan Africa and in multidisciplinary and international teams will be an advantage.
  • Experience with social determinants of health, food security, or equity-focused analyses in health research is particularly desirable.
  • Experience in grant writing or participation in funding applications is an advantage.
  • Demonstrating previous experience of working with mixed-methods research, implementation research and working in a multidisciplinary team in low-resource settings would be an advantage. 

Personal skills

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is highly motivated to pursue an academic career.
  • Can work independently and systematically, while being an engaged team player.
  • Has strong organizational and project management skills and can handle complex coordination tasks across partners and countries.
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can communicate effectively with clinicians, researchers, students, community representatives and policymakers.
  • Can take initiative and demonstrate strong, equitable and shared leadership skills in an international, multidisciplinary environment, fostering co‑ownership among partners 
  • Is willing and able to spend longer periods in Tanzania (e.g. for fieldwork, coordination and collaboration).

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

title: Would you like to help shape the next chapter of Aimo Park’s commercial development?
description:
We are looking for a Commercial Director who will take a key position in Aimo Park Norway’s management team, with a clear mandate to strengthen the commercial organisation and drive further profitable growth.

The role:

As Commercial Director, you will have overall responsibility for New Business in Norway and lead the commercial sales team. You will identify new market opportunities, develop strong customer and partner relationships, and contribute to the development and commercialisation of new services, concepts and business models.

The role spans strategy and execution. You will develop the sales strategy, drive structured sales processes, identify new revenue opportunities and play a key role in major tenders, contract negotiations and commercial discussions. You will also work closely with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Legal, Technology and Marketing.

An important part of your mandate will be to further develop the commercial function - its people, processes and ways of working - ensuring that the organisation is equipped for continued growth.

You have:
  • a university degree in Business, Economics or equivalent
  • a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience with a proven track record in commercial roles
  • solid experience in B2B sales and business development
  • proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and lead a commercial team
  • experience in strategic sales and in translating strategy into tangible commercial results
  • strong commercial and financial acumen
  • experience with complex customer processes, contracts and negotiations
  • an analytical approach and the ability to use data and market insight to identify opportunities for growth and profitability
  • excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English, written and spoken
It is an advantage if you have:
  • experience from real estate or other transaction- and contract-intensive businesses
  • relevant industry experience
  • experience in developing and commercialising new services, concepts or business models
  • experience with partnerships and the development of new revenue streams
Who are you?

We believe you are self-driven, curious and results-oriented, with the ability to see both the bigger picture and what it takes to turn opportunities into tangible results.

You are comfortable challenging established ways of working, while doing so constructively. You build trust, bring people with you and combine analytical strength with creativity and commercial instinct. Most importantly, you are motivated by creating and developing, rather than simply managing what already exists.

Why Aimo Park?

At Aimo Park, you get the strength and stability of an established market leader - combined with the opportunities of a market undergoing rapid transformation.

Digitalisation, changing customer expectations and evolving business models are reshaping both parking and mobility, creating significant new commercial opportunities.

You will have considerable influence, short decision-making paths and a genuine opportunity to help define how Aimo Park will grow and compete in the years ahead.

 

Location: Oslo
Application deadline: 8 November 2026

 

Aimo Park is partnering with Jefferson Wells for this recruitment. For further information about the position, please contact Senior Advisor Kristine Bugge Lie Owe at Jefferson Wells at Kristine.owe@jeffersonwells.no or +47 40 72 40 05.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Aimo Park is a leading provider of parking and mobility solutions in Norway - and a trusted partner to property owners across the country. With a strong market position, solid financial foundation and a continuous focus on developing new digital solutions and services, we have a strong platform for growth. Now, we are ready for the next step.

title: King of the Road trenger flere med på laget!
description:
Noen velger yrke, andre velger livsstil.
 
Hos Scania Kløfta jobber vi ikke bare med lastebiler. Vi jobber med et varemerke som vekker stolthet. Scania er kjent langt utover verkstedgulvet, og det finnes folk som bærer griffen på både klær, vegger, og noen ganger til og med tatovert på kroppen. Men hos oss handler det først og fremst om noe annet: dyktige folk som er stolte av faget sitt.
Hver dag kommer lastebiler inn og ut av verkstedet vårt i Kløfta. Kundene våre forventer kvalitet, kompetanse og løsninger som holder dem på veien. Det ansvaret tar vi på alvor.
For å fortsette å levere på det nivået vi er kjent for, ønsker vi nå å styrke laget med flere mekanikere. Er dette kanskje deg?
 
Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi søker to nye mekanikere til oss. Du trenger ikke ha Scania-logoen tatovert, men du må ha interesse for faget.
Vi ønsker at du har relevant fagbrev og erfaring som mekaniker, enten fra tungbil, bil, anlegg, landbruk eller industri. Du liker å løse tekniske utfordringer, har interesse for moderne kjøretøy og ønsker å utvikle deg videre.
Du jobber strukturert, samarbeider godt med andre og tar stolthet i arbeidet du leverer.
 
Hva kan vi tilby deg?
Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og godt samhold. Du får jobbe i et moderne verksted med moderne utstyr, og du får muligheten til å utvikle deg gjennom kurs, opplæring og nye utfordringer.
Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger og en trygg arbeidsgiver med et av bransjens sterkeste varemerker. Her blir du satset på - og her kan du bli lenge.
 
Er du klar?
Vil du bli en del av laget i Kløfta? Send oss gjerne en søknad allerede i dag. Vi behandler søknader fortløpende.
Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Distriktssjef Jan Erik Dokken +4794985111.

title: Kundeveileder
description:
Mer enn "bare en butikkjobb"

Som en del av Remiks Miljøpark er du opptatt av det store bildet. Du aksepterer kollegaer og kunder som de er, med alle de ulikheter vi mennesker bærer på.

Som kundeveileder på Rebell Remiks Bærekraftsenter brenner du ekstra for miljøet, og anser samarbeid som et viktig verktøy for å skape en levedyktig klode.

Bærekraftsenteret er og skal være mer enn en bruktbutikk. Rebell skal være fyrtårnet for miljøsamarbeid i Nord-Norge. 
Vi søker deg som kan jobbe i fast og 100% stilling.

Arbeid i helger og ettermiddager må påregnes. Bærekraftsenteret har et dynamisk miljø, og det er gode muligheter for varierte arbeidsdager.


Dine arbeidsoppgaver

En kundeveileder på Rebell har ulike ansvarsoppgaver:

  • Kundebehandling i drive-in varemottak og butikk
  • Mottak, testing og klargjøring av gjenbruksvarer
  • Mindre reparasjoner
  • Prising og systematisering, forefallende lagerarbeid
  • Vareplassering i butikk, utstillinger og kampanjer
  • Betjening av kassapunkter
  • Vertskapsoppgaver ved kurs, møter og arrangementer

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Du har et engasjement for bærekraft, gjenbruk, redesign eller miljøet. - Eller alt på en gang!
  • Du er glad i å være med mennesker og behandler alle med respekt
  • Du håndterer hektiske perioder - og evner å fylle rolige stunder med arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du vil lære av andre og dele egne kunnskaper
  • Du kan å smile :-)
  • Du er bittelitt REBELLsk!

Vi tilbyr
  • Anledning til å være med og forme Nord-Norges kuleste Bærekraftsenter
  • Et dynamisk og trivelig miljø
  • En varm velkomst i Remiks-familien
  • Fast heltidsstilling, med gode lønns- og pensjonsvilkår
  • All nødvendig opplæring
  • Relevant kurs- og kompetanseheving
    (truckførerbevis, opplæring datasystemer m.v.)

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Remiks som eier Rebell er et avfallsselskap som samler inn, håndterer og behandler avfall i Nord-Norge. Vi tilbyr avfallsløsninger for næringslivet og utfører lovpålagte oppgaver gjennom innsamling av husholdningsavfall i Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune.
Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i våre verdier miljøbevisst, pålitelig, nyskapende og tilgjengelig. Disse verdiene er forankret i alt vi gjør og våre ansatte er våre fremste ambassadører for disse verdiene.
 

Rebell Remiks Bærekraftsenter skal gå til kamp for miljøet og en levedyktig klode. Bærekraftsenteret er et fyrtårn for miljøsamarbeidet i Nord-Norge. Vårt mål er å pirke i miljønerven din, utvikle den slik at du gir noen andre muligheten til å gjenbruke det du ikke har bruk for selv, og likens skal du også kunne fryde deg over dine egne skills innen ombruk, fiksing og reparasjoner.

Rebell er mer enn en bruktbutikk. I tillegg til et stort utvalg gjenbruksvarer finner du kurs og arrangementer, happenings og aktiviteter og ikke minst et trivelig sted å være, med lave skuldre og stor takhøyde.

Vi er underlagt offentlighetsloven, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. CV kan også bli benyttet til utvidet søkerliste. Du vil i søknadsprosessen kunne anmode om å ikke bli oppført i søkerlisten, og må da angi en begrunnelse. I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Du vil bli varslet om anmodningen ikke tas til følge.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Multi-modal microscopy and tomography of virus-infected organoids
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in the development of multimodal microscopy for studying viral infection in organoids, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

Investigating viral interactions within host cells at the single-particle level poses significant challenges due to the resolution limitations of conventional microscopy, particularly in complex organoid tissue sections and lack of multi-modality approach. To overcome these obstacles, it is necessary to develop and apply multi-modal optical microscopy methods, such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy and label-free optical diffraction tomography and quantitative phase microscopy. Another important aspect of this project is to perform advance image analysis on correlative datasets to extract the underlying knowledge. The technical aspect of this project aims to integrate two cutting-edge microscopy platforms, photonic chip-based multimodal microscopy and quantitative phase microscopy (QPM)/optical diffraction tomography. These instruments will be used to study viral infections in organoid models (such as gut and brain). Post-imaging, we will conduct advanced image analysis, develop different models for correlative imaging and on label-free images. As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other DC such as DC 1, DC 6 DC 8 and DC 10.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 5) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 5 will be:

  • To develop and adapt a multi-modal optical microscopy platform with focus on two modalities, a) photonic chip-based super-resolution optical microscopy and b) optical diffraction tomography & quantitative phase microscopy.
  • To perform correlative fluorescence optical microscopy with 3D quantitative phase tomography to facilitate virtual specificity
  • To generate correlated datasets for analysis of microenvironmental changes during HIV-1 and VEEV infection. To use organoid sections, intact organoids and cells models in this study.
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted segmentation, classification and correlation
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to imaging, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Prof. Dag Kristian Dysthe. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.


How to apply

Application deadline: October 30, 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application:

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or engineering or related field in biomedical engineering and biophysics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system. Master dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date,
  • Solid, hands-on experience with experimental optical instrumentation, including the development, alignment, operation and/or application of optical microscopy systems,
  • Strong background in image analysis or similar scientific data analysis using Python or MATLAB,
  • An interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group.

Desired qualifications:

  • Background in adapting or development of optical microscopy platforms such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy, diffraction tomography or quantitative phase microscopy systems,
  • Machine learning or AI-assisted analysis of microscopy or other high-dimensional imaging datasets,
  • Image reconstruction and computational microscopy, including algorithms for super-resolution microscopy, phase retrieval, quantitative phase imaging, or optical diffraction tomography,
  • Advanced image analysis, including image registration, segmentation, feature extraction, classification, and correlative/multimodal image analysis.
  • Experience in bioimaging and handling of biological samples,
  • As the target applications involve organoids and viruses, it is beneficial if the candidate have experience working with various biological specimen such as tissue sections or organoid samples,
  • Willingness to collaborate within an international research network and undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


General MERIT eligibility criteria
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment, 1 April 2027. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


What are we looking for in you?

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and AF micro-spectroscopy
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and autofluorescence micro-spectroscopy, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

This doctoral project will develop and apply advanced label-free optical spectroscopy approaches to investigate molecular and metabolic changes in organoid models of viral infection. The project will combine Raman micro-spectroscopy and UV–visible autofluorescence (AF) spectroscopy, providing complementary information on the biochemical and metabolic state of biological samples without requiring external fluorescent labels. Raman micro-spectroscopy, primarily using 785 nm excitation, will obtain molecular fingerprints associated with lipids, proteins, nucleic acids and metabolites. Complementary UV–visible autofluorescence spectroscopy in the 350–500 nm spectral range will probe endogenous fluorescence signatures associated with cellular metabolism and biochemical composition. The project will investigate both free-space spectroscopy and waveguide-enhanced spectroscopic approaches, including waveguide-enhanced Raman and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy, with the aim of improving sensitivity to subtle molecular changes.

Photonic waveguides provide strong and spatially extended light–matter interaction through the evanescent optical field, offering opportunities to enhance Raman signals and AF-signals and improve sensitivity compared with conventional free-space measurements. Particular emphasis will be placed on identifying spectral signatures associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming that may precede observable structural changes. AI-assisted spectral analysis will be explored to analyse the high-dimensional Raman and autofluorescence datasets. Machine-learning approaches will be used to identify spectral features and molecular signatures associated with infection, distinguish different biological states, and correlate spectroscopic changes with disease progression. The project will use organoid models of HIV-1 and Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) infection.

As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other doctoral candidates (DC): DC 5, DC 9-10 and DC 12.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 6) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 6 will be:

  • To develop and adapt Raman and autofluorescence spectroscopy platform,
  • To explore both free space and optical waveguide-enhanced Raman spectroscopy and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy,
  • To apply these spectroscopy tools for organoid sections, analytes and virus,
  • To generate spectral signatures (Raman and AF- library) associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming during HIV-1 and VEEV infection,
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted spectral analysis for high-dimensional Raman and AF- signals,
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to spectroscopy, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Associated Professor Elisabeth Wetzer. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:
